sum: This study introduces a physics-informed neural network (PINN) solver designed for a coupled spring-slider system that integrates rate-and-state friction with dynamic pore-pressure and porosity evolution. To address the stiff and strongly coupled nature of these hydromechanical models, the authors implement adaptive inverse-residual weighting and a two-stage optimization workflow (Adam followed by L-BFGS). In forward simulations, the PINN predictions match Runge-Kutta reference solutions for steady sliding and slow-slip transients with high accuracy. In inverse experiments, the framework successfully recovers the applied normal stress from noisy shear-stress observations, demonstrating its potential as a differentiable alternative for parameter inversion in complex fault models.
本研究针对速率-状态摩擦与孔隙压/孔隙度演化耦合的弹簧-滑块系统，开发了一种物理信息神经网络（PINN）求解器。为解决该多物理场耦合模型的刚性与强耦合难题，采用了自适应逆残差权重和两阶段优化策略（Adam后接L-BFGS）。正演模拟中，PINN预测结果与Runge-Kutta参考解高度吻合；反演实验……

t: A physics-informed neural network (PINN) solver incorporating rate-and-state friction and pore-pressure differential equations, optimized via adaptive inverse-residual weighting and a two-stage Adam/L-BFGS scheme.
融合速率-状态摩擦与孔隙压微分方程的PINN求解器，采用自适应逆残差权重与两阶段优化。
Synthetic time-series data of block velocity, shear stress, and pore pressure generated from a coupled spring-slider system, used for forward validation and noisy inverse testing.
基于耦合弹簧-滑块系统生成的块体速度、剪切应力和孔隙压合成时间序列数据。
PINN forward predictions achieved a normalized mean squared error below 0.08, and inverse experiments recovered normal stress within 1% deviation under high noise levels.
正演预测归一化均方误差低于0.08，高噪声反演中推导的法向应力偏差小于1%。
The analysis is restricted to a zero-dimensional spring-slider approximation of fault slip and pore-pressure coupling.
目前仅局限于零维弹簧-滑块近似模型，未考虑空间扩展的断层动力学。
First application of PINNs to coupled rate-and-state friction and dynamic pore-pressure/porosity evolution, resolving stiffness issues using adaptive weighting and hybrid optimization.
首次将PINN应用于速率-状态摩擦与动态孔隙压耦合系统，解决了刚性方程的训练稳定性难题。

kc: Developed a physics-informed neural network (PINN) solver for coupled rate-and-state friction and dynamic pore-pressure evolution.
Implemented adaptive inverse-residual weighting and a two-stage optimization schedule (Adam and L-BFGS) to stabilize training on stiff differential equations.
Demonstrated successful parameter inversion by recovering applied normal stress from noisy shear-stress observations.
开发了针对速率-状态摩擦与动态孔隙压演化耦合系统的物理信息神经网络（PINN）求解器。
引入了自适应逆残差权重和两阶段优化方案（Adam与L-BFGS），以稳定刚性微分方程的训练过程。
通过从含噪声的剪切应力观测中成功恢复施加的法向应力，验证了参数反演能力。

Adaptive inverse-residual weighting for loss function balancing.
Two-stage optimization using Adam followed by L-BFGS.
融合速率-状态摩擦和孔隙压演化控制微分方程的物理信息神经网络（PINN）。

Synthetic inverse experiments to recover normal stress under varying levels of observational noise (up to q = 1).

sum: This study presents a high-resolution 3-D P-wave attenuation tomography model of the northern Chilean subduction zone (21°–22°S) using the coda-normalization approach in the MuRAT algorithm. Utilizing 147,639 high-quality waveforms from 42,460 local earthquakes recorded by 76 broadband stations (2007–2021), the authors image two prominent low-Q (high attenuation) anomalies. The first anomaly lies along the top of the subducting Nazca slab (50–90 km depth), indicating fluid release from slab dehydration. The second anomaly ascends from the mantle wedge toward the lower crust beneath the volcanic arc, tracing fluid migration pathways. These low-Q zones correlate with high-Vp/Vs regions and sit above high-seismicity zones, confirming that intraslab earthquakes are closely linked to dehydration processes.
本研究利用MuRAT算法中的尾波归一化方法，构建了智利北部俯冲带（21°–22°S）的高分辨率三维P波衰减断层成像模型。研究使用了2007至2021年间76个宽频带台站记录的42,460个地方震的147,639条高质量波形。衰减模型揭示了两个主要的低Q值（高衰减）异常区：一个位于俯冲纳斯卡板块顶部5……

t: 3-D P-wave attenuation tomography using the coda-normalization method implemented in the MuRAT (Multi-Resolution seismic Attenuation Tomography) algorithm.
利用MuRAT算法中实现的尾波归一化方法进行三维P波衰减断层成像。
147,639 high-quality waveforms from 42,460 local earthquakes recorded by 76 broadband stations in northern Chile between 2007 and 2021.
使用智利北部76个宽频带台站在2007至2021年间记录的42,460个地方地震的147,639条高质量波形。
Imaged two low-Q anomalies: one along the subducting slab top (50-90 km depth) indicating dehydration, and another ascending from the mantle wedge to the volcanic arc.
成像出两个低Q异常区：一个位于俯冲板块顶部（50-90km），另一个自地幔楔上升至火山弧。
Resolution and parameterization are bounded by the 10 km node spacing of the velocity model and 14x25x10 km attenuation grid.

首次在该段俯冲带获得高分辨率三维衰减模型，连续追踪了从板块脱水到火山弧的流体通道。

me: Coda-normalization method for attenuation measurements.
Multi-Resolution seismic Attenuation Tomography (MuRAT) algorithm.
3-D inversion parameterized on a 14 x 25 x 10 km grid using a pre-existing 3-D velocity model.

sum: This study investigates the paleoseismic history of the two conjugate faults that ruptured during the 2019 Ridgecrest, California earthquake sequence: the Salt Wells Valley fault (SWVF) and the Paxton Ranch fault (PRF). By excavating five paleoseismic trenches and using luminescence dating, the authors show that the SWVF has a very low slip rate (0.01-0.09 mm/yr) and has only ruptured once prior to 2019 in the last 17-27 ka. In contrast, the PRF is much more active (0.2-1.3 mm/yr) with multiple Holocene and late Pleistocene events. This contrasting behavior demonstrates that the 2019 conjugate rupture was an unusual pairing of a highly active dextral fault and a low-activity sinistral fault, suggesting that seismic hazard is governed by complex, time-dependent fault network interactions rather than repeatable individual fault behavior.
本研究调查了2019年美国加州Ridgecrest地震序列中发生破裂的两条共轭断层（Salt Wells Valley断层和Paxton Ranch断层）的古地震历史。通过开挖5个古地震探槽并结合发光测年技术，研究发现Salt Wells Valley断层活动性极低（滑移率0.01-0.09 mm/……

t: Excavation of five paleoseismic trenches combined with luminescence dating of sedimentary strata to constrain the timing of past surface-rupturing earthquakes.
开挖5个古地震探槽并结合沉积地层的发光测年，以约束历史地表破裂地震的时间。
Stratigraphic exposures and luminescence ages from five trenches across the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake ruptures.
横跨2019年Ridgecrest地震破裂带的5个探槽的地层剖面和发光测年数据。
The Paxton Ranch fault has a slip rate of 0.2-1.3 mm/yr, whereas the Salt Wells Valley fault has a much lower slip rate of 0.01-0.09 mm/yr.
Paxton Ranch断层滑移率为0.2-1.3 mm/yr，而Salt Wells Valley断层滑移率仅为0.0…
The findings suggest that synchronous conjugate rupture is not systematic but varies within an evolving network, complicating simple hazard models.
同步共轭破裂并非系统性发生，而是随断层网络演化而变化，增加了危险性评估的复杂性。
Demonstrates that the 2019 conjugate rupture represents an unusual pairing of faults with highly contrasting recurrence intervals rather than a repeatable, systematic process.
首次证实2019年共轭破裂是高活动性右旋断层与低活动性左旋断层的罕见非系统性组合。

kc: Established the paleoseismic histories and event chronologies for both the Salt Wells Valley and Paxton Ranch faults.
Determined slip rates of 0.2-1.3 mm/yr for the Paxton Ranch fault and 0.01-0.09 mm/yr for the Salt Wells Valley fault.
Demonstrated that synchronous conjugate ruptures in the Ridgecrest region are non-systematic and vary within an evolving fault network.
建立了Salt Wells Valley断层和Paxton Ranch断层的古地震历史和事件年代学。
确定了Paxton Ranch断层的滑移率为0.2-1.3 mm/yr，而Salt Wells Valley断层的滑移率为0.01-0.09 mm/yr。

Luminescence dating of sedimentary strata to constrain paleo-earthquake timing.
Slip rate estimation based on 2019 displacements and paleoseismic event intervals.

sum: This study investigates the physical mechanisms driving back-propagating earthquake rupture (BPR) fronts. Using numerical simulations of dynamic rupture, the authors demonstrate that a low ratio of initial shear stress to effective normal stress (τ0/σeff) promotes pulse-like ruptures. Hydraulic heterogeneity within the fault zone induces BPR through complex interactions among slip rate, shear stress, and fault healing. The back-propagating fronts are sustained by residual stress and are initiated when the local stress drop exceeds the analytical critical threshold required for re-rupture. This work provides key theoretical insights into complex rupture styles on heterogeneous faults.
本研究探讨了地震后向传播破裂（BPR）前锋的物理机制。通过动力学破裂数值模拟，研究表明较低的初始剪应力与有效正应力比（τ0/σeff）有利于促进脉冲状破裂。断层带内的流体动力学非均匀性通过滑动速率、剪应力和断层愈合之间的相互作用诱发了BPR。后向传播前锋由残余应力维持，并在局部应力降超过重新破裂的解……

t: Numerical modeling of dynamic earthquake rupture incorporating hydraulic heterogeneity, friction, and fault healing mechanisms.
结合流体非均匀性、摩擦和断层愈合机制的地震动力学破裂数值模拟。
Synthetic dynamic rupture simulations under varying initial shear stress, effective normal stress, and hydraulic properties.
在不同初始剪应力、有效正应力和流体动力学性质下的合成动力学破裂模拟。
BPR initiates when local stress drop exceeds the analytical critical threshold for re-rupture, sustained by residual stress.
当局部应力降超过重新破裂的解析临界阈值时，由残余应力维持的BPR即会启动。
The simplified analytical threshold and 2D/3D model assumptions may not capture full geometric fault complexity.
简化的解析阈值和模型假设可能无法完全捕捉天然断层的复杂几何结构。
Linking hydraulic heterogeneity directly to back-propagating rupture fronts via an analytical re-rupture threshold.
通过解析重新破裂阈值，将断层流体非均匀性与后向传播破裂前锋直接联系起来。

kc: Demonstrated that low τ0/σeff ratios promote pulse-like ruptures with back-propagating fronts.
Identified fault hydraulic heterogeneity as a key driver for BPR through slip-rate, stress, and healing feedback.

确定了断层流体非均匀性是通过滑动速率、应力和愈合相互作用诱发BPR的关键驱动因素。

Analytical threshold derivation for fault re-rupture under heterogeneous stress conditions.

sum: This study evaluates the performance of the modified USGS regional velocity model adopted for the CyberShake 24.8 (CS24.8) study in the San Francisco Bay Area. By comparing 3-D finite-difference simulations (0-1 Hz and 1-5 Hz) with recorded ground motions from 18 small-to-moderate local earthquakes, the authors analyze Fourier amplitude spectra (FAS) and waveform durations. They find that the model underpredicts FAS (by 0.1 to 0.5 LN-units at 0.3-1 Hz) and underpredicts duration by a factor of 2, primarily due to the 400 m/s minimum shear-wave velocity limit which is too high for soft marine sediments. The results show that while the 3-D model improves wave propagation accuracy compared to ergodic ground-motion models below 0.7 Hz, the velocity structure remains too smooth.
本研究评估了旧金山湾区CyberShake 24.8 (CS24.8)研究所采用的修改版USGS区域速度模型。通过将18个中小局部地震的三维有限差分模拟（0-1 Hz和1-5 Hz）与实际观测记录进行对比，分析了傅里叶振幅谱（FAS）和波形持续时间。结果表明，该模型低估了FAS（在0.3-1 Hz处……

t: 3-D regional-scale physics-based finite-difference simulations up to 1 Hz, combined with a stochastic scheme with site-specific adjustments for frequencies up to 5 Hz.
采用基于物理的三维区域有限差分模拟（1 Hz以下），结合随机方法进行高频（最高5 Hz）模拟。
Observed and simulated ground-motion waveforms from 18 small-to-moderate local earthquakes in the San Francisco Bay Area, evaluating Fourier amplitude spectra and duration.
旧金山湾区18个中小局部地震的实际观测与模拟地面运动波形，对比分析其振幅谱和持续时间。
The velocity model underpredicts FAS by 0.1-0.5 LN-units (0.3-1 Hz) and duration by a factor of 2, due to the 400 m/s minimum shear-wave velocity limit.
由于400 m/s的最小剪切波速限制，模型低估了FAS（0.1-0.5 LN单位）并将持续时间低估了一半。
The 3-D velocity structure is too smooth, resulting in lower spatial variability of simulated FAS compared to observations in the 0.3 to 1 Hz range.
三维速度结构过于平滑，导致在0.3至1 Hz频段内模拟的地面运动空间变异性低于实际观测。
Quantifies wave-propagation uncertainties of the CyberShake 24.8 model and demonstrates that 3-D simulations improve wave propagation accuracy over empirical GMMs below 0.7 Hz.
定量评估了CyberShake 24.8模型的传播不确定性，并证明三维模拟在0.7 Hz以下优于经验GMM。

Identified systematic underprediction of ground-motion amplitudes and durations caused by the 400 m/s minimum shear-wave velocity threshold.
Demonstrated that 3-D simulations outperform ergodic ground-motion models (GMMs) for wave propagation effects at frequencies below 0.7 Hz.

sum: This paper presents a diffusion-guided framework for structurally preconditioned velocity-model reconstruction from sparse well-log information. The proposed approach integrates plane-wave PDE regularization, structurally preconditioned inversion, and measurement-guided diffusion posterior sampling (DDIM) into a unified formulation. Local structural slopes estimated via plane-wave destruction propagate well information along geological dips and guide the diffusion process through a joint velocity-slope generative prior. Tested on the Volve synthetic model and Viking Graben field dataset, the method improves structural continuity and geological realism compared to conventional approaches.
本文提出了一种利用稀疏井筒信息进行结构预条件速度模型重建的扩散引导框架。该方法将平面波PDE正则化、结构预条件反演和测量引导的扩散后验采样（DDIM）整合到统一的公式中。通过平面波破坏估计的局部结构倾角，既能沿地质倾向传播井筒信息，又能通过联合速度-倾角生成先验引导扩散采样过程。在Volve合成模型……

t: A diffusion-guided framework combining plane-wave PDE regularization, structurally preconditioned inversion, and measurement-guided diffusion posterior sampling (DDIM) with a joint velocity-slope generative prior.
结合平面波PDE正则化、结构预条件反演和联合速度-倾角扩散后验采样的生成式框架。
Sparse well-log information applied to the Volve synthetic model and the Viking Graben field dataset.
应用于Volve合成模型和Viking Graben实际场数据集的稀疏井测曲线数据。

sum: This study introduces the Quake Neural Operator (QNO), a multi-task deep learning algorithm designed to build earthquake catalogs directly from continuous seismic data without explicit phase picking. QNO utilizes classification and regression to detect and locate events across arbitrary seismic network geometries. When applied to the Geysers geothermal field, QNO successfully characterized events where state-of-the-art phase picking failed, identifying nearly an order of magnitude more seismic detections than reported in routine catalogs. The results are validated through comparison with the Phase Neural Operator and visual inspection, demonstrating QNO's potential to enhance microseismic monitoring and subsurface characterization.

sum: The paper proposes MABLE, a self-supervised graph representation learning framework designed for large, heterogeneous geospatial datasets, demonstrated on mineral-exploration data. It combines masked autoencoding with fixed cosine-similarity losses to align augmented views while maintaining embedding spread. A bi-Lipschitz feature decoder links low-dimensional node embeddings to feature similarity, and Lipschitz-controlled pooling stabilizes graph-level representations. Applied to local copper and regional Arabian Shield datasets, MABLE generates coherent embedding-derived layers for hypothesis generation without requiring learned discriminators or hard-negative selection.

sum: This study proposes a self-supervised deep-learning-based denoising method integrating LSTM and auto-encoder architectures. By leveraging ultra-low-background seismic data from the Huainan Deep Underground Laboratory and synchronous surface observations, the model learns clean wavefield features to adaptively denoise heavily contaminated surface data. For ambient noise, it suppresses high-frequency noise above 1 Hz with a suppression ratio of 0.986. For seismic events, it improves the signal-to-noise ratio by up to 8.21 dB. Single-component processing preserves low-frequency fidelity better, whereas three-component joint processing yields superior high-frequency attenuation.

sum: This study applies three deep-learning phase pickers (EQTransformer, GPD, and PhaseNet) alongside PyOcto association and Hypoinverse/hypoDD relocation to continuous seismic data (2014–2023) in Hispaniola. The resulting aggregated catalog contains over 47,000 earthquakes, tripling the size of local network catalogs. This high-resolution dataset illuminates low-magnitude seismicity along major fault zones (e.g., Enriquillo–Plantain Garden and Septentrional–Oriente) and resolves the complex subducting slab geometries. The relocated seismicity supports double-slab interaction models east of ~70° W, where the north-dipping Caribbean slab meets the south-dipping North American slab, demonstrating the power of ML workflows in complex tectonic settings.

sum: This study applies the horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) method to ambient noise data collected from five three-component nodal seismometers over one year (2023) to monitor the Huangtupo Linjiang Number 1 landslide in the Three Gorges Reservoir area. The authors analyze temporal variations in peak frequencies and amplification factors to identify distinct hydrological responses in shallow versus deep sliding zones. Reservoir water-level rise decreases peak frequencies and amplification factors in shallow zones due to increased pore-water pressure and reduced shear-wave velocity, whereas deep zones show weaker sensitivity. Modal decomposition highlights the dominant control of reservoir water-level fluctuations over transient rainfall, and spatial analysis reveals stronger hydrological influences on the landslide's frontal zone.

sum: This paper introduces a novel workflow that utilizes Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro large language model (LLM) to automate the extraction and structuring of macroseismic observations from unstructured legacy reports. The authors apply this method to the 1957 M 5.3 Daly City and 1971 ML 6.7 Sylmar earthquakes in California. By extracting addresses, original Modified Mercalli intensity values, and descriptions, and geocoding them via Google's Geocoding API, they successfully generated over 2300 geocoded intensity reports for the Daly City event. The resulting shaking intensity maps rival modern 'Did You Feel It?' maps, demonstrating that LLMs offer a highly scalable and reliable solution for digitizing historical seismological archives to improve seismic hazard models and site-effect studies.

sum: This paper introduces Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) to accelerate forward and inverse mantle convection modeling. By transforming numerical solvers into neural operators, the authors build surrogate models that map convecting thermal states across long time intervals and enable gradient calculation via auto-differentiation. They evaluate four thermal state reconstruction methods: reverse buoyancy, reverse convection operator, terminal-state inversion, and a joint inversion incorporating both the terminal thermal state and surface velocity evolution. The joint inversion is shown to overcome the noise sensitivity of the reverse convection operator, offering a promising, computationally efficient framework for large-scale geodynamic reconstructions using seismic tomography and plate tectonics.

sum: This theoretical and computational study investigates the scaling relationships between the breakdown zone (cohesive zone) and heterogeneous frictional properties during dynamic earthquake ruptures. By modeling ruptures propagating along faults with spatially variable frictional parameters, the authors analyze how heterogeneity influences the spatial and temporal evolution of the breakdown zone. The work provides critical insights into earthquake source physics, showing how small-scale frictional variations map onto macroscopic rupture parameters, which has implications for understanding earthquake nucleation, propagation, and arrest.

sum: This study presents fluid dynamically consistent numerical simulations of the plume-lithosphere system to investigate the origin of precursory carbonatite eruptions associated with Large Igneous Provinces (LIPs). By tracking millions of passive tracers, the authors model the 3-D trajectories and ascent velocities of carbonate melts originating from the plume rather than the lithosphere. For carbonatite melts produced at 200 km depth, the precursory carbon flux can reach up to 6e11 mol/yr for ~2 Myr before anhydrous silicate melting begins. This mechanism explains precursory carbonatite complexes in the Paraná and Deccan provinces, and suggests that early plume-derived carbon emissions could have driven environmental perturbations and mass extinctions, such as during the end-Triassic CAMP event.

sum: This study investigates the evolution of the magma plumbing system beneath the Puyehue-Cordón Caulle volcanic complex in the Andean Southern Volcanic Zone. It focuses on how the loading and subsequent post-glacial unloading of the Patagonian ice sheet influenced magma storage, transport, and eruption dynamics. By linking glacial history with magmatic processes, the paper highlights the mechanical feedback between surface cryospheric changes and deep crustal magmatic systems.

sum: This study evaluates the feasibility of integrating borehole distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) with surface geophone nodes for shallow subsurface characterization at a complex urban archaeological site. Using active and passive seismic methods, the authors reconstruct P-wave velocity models from first-arrival travel times and S-wave velocity models from Rayleigh wave dispersion curves. Additionally, they demonstrate the potential of interwell ambient noise interferometry using passive DAS data. The results show that integrated DAS and node acquisition provides a flexible, non-invasive, and highly effective approach for small-scale civil engineering and archaeological investigations, especially in logistically challenging urban environments where active sources may be restricted.

sum: This study utilizes Sentinel-1 InSAR data to investigate the deformation response of the Yarlung Zangbo suture (YZS) in southern Tibet following the 2015 MW 7.8 Gorkha (Nepal) earthquake. While the neighboring Xainza-Dinggyê rift experienced elevated seismicity, the YZS remained seismically quiet. However, post-seismic geodetic data reveal a clear dextral transient creep along the suture that was absent in pre-seismic observations, indicating triggered aseismic slip. This finding provides direct evidence that the YZS is active and accommodates shear strain between central Tibet and the rigid Indian plate, highlighting diverse fault responses to earthquake-induced stress loading.
本研究利用Sentinel-1卫星InSAR数据，分析了2015年尼泊尔MW 7.8戈尔哈地震后藏南雅鲁藏布江缝合带（YZS）的变形响应。邻近的申扎-定结裂谷地震活动显著增加，而YZS在震后保持地震平静。然而，大地测量数据显示缝合带上出现了明显的右旋瞬态蠕变，且该信号在震前并不存在，证实其为地震触发……

t: Sentinel-1 InSAR time-series analysis was used to map the surface deformation field before and after the 2015 Gorkha earthquake.
利用Sentinel-1 InSAR时间序列分析技术获取2015年戈尔哈地震前后的地表形变场。
Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar (SAR) data spanning the periods before and after the 2015 MW 7.8 Gorkha earthquake.
覆盖2015年MW 7.8戈尔哈地震前后时段的Sentinel-1合成孔径雷达（SAR）数据。
The post-Gorkha deformation field shows clear dextral transient creep on the Yarlung Zangbo suture, which was absent in pre-Gorkha data.
震后形变场显示雅鲁藏布江缝合带存在明显的右旋瞬态蠕变，而震前数据中未发现该信号。
The physical mechanism and depth of the aseismic slip patch remain simplified due to reliance on surface geodetic data.
由于主要依赖地表大地测量数据，无震滑动的物理机制和深部细节仍有待深入约束。
First observation of triggered aseismic dextral creep on the Yarlung Zangbo suture, confirming its active role in accommodating regional shear strain.

sum: This paper evaluates deep learning models for multi-domain event detection (including Hi-net seismic and Utah FORGE borehole DAS data) to disentangle fault tolerance (sensor loss) from low-SNR robustness. Using a unified 8-channel benchmark, the author compares a fault-tolerant detector (CEPHALON) against standard CNN, TCN, and Transformer baselines. While all models perform well on clean data, CEPHALON degrades much more gracefully under additive noise (AUC of 0.939 at -2.5 dB vs. 0.532-0.572 for baselines). Ablation studies reveal that the training recipe (specifically sensor-dropout training) is the dominant cause of this low-SNR robustness, rather than parallel architectural redundancy.
本文评估了用于多领域事件检测（包括Hi-net地震和Utah FORGE井下DAS数据）的深度学习模型，以解耦容错性（传感器丢失）与低信噪比（SNR）鲁棒性。作者构建了统一的8通道基准数据集，对比了容错检测器（CEPHALON）与标准CNN、TCN和Transformer。在干净数据上所有模型表现优……

t: A fault-tolerant detector (CEPHALON) with parallel redundancy is trained using per-sample sensor-dropout and compared against 1D CNN, TCN, and Transformer baselines.
使用样本级传感器丢弃训练具有并行冗余的容错检测器，并与CNN、TCN和Transformer对比。
A unified binary event-detection benchmark mapping Hi-net seismic waveforms, Utah FORGE 2024 borehole DAS, and MAFAULDA industrial vibration to an 8-channel, 256-sample format.
将Hi-net地震波形、Utah FORGE井下DAS和MAFAULDA振动数据统一为8通道、256采样点格式。
Under additive noise at -2.5 dB, CEPHALON achieves an AUC of 0.939 compared to 0.532-0.572 for convolutional baselines, driven primarily by sensor-dropout training.
在-2.5 dB噪声下，CEPHALON的AUC达到0.939，而卷积基线仅为0.532-0.572。
The study focuses on binary event detection on a highly standardized 8-channel, 256-sample format, which may simplify real-world array geometries.
研究仅限于标准化的8通道、256采样点格式的二分类事件检测。
Disentangles fault tolerance from low-SNR robustness, proving that sensor-dropout training, rather than complex parallel architecture, is the primary driver of noise robustness.
解耦了容错性与低信噪比鲁棒性，证明传感器丢弃训练是噪声鲁棒性的主要驱动力。

Comparative evaluation against 1D Convolutional Network, Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN), and compact Transformer baselines.

Utah FORGE 2024 borehole Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data.

sum: This study presents a theoretical framework to quantify the equivalent Biot coefficient tensor of fractured rock masses using properties of both the intact porous matrix and the fracture network. The author demonstrates that dominant fracture sets produce an anisotropic equivalent Biot tensor, with larger values perpendicular to the fractures. This anisotropy significantly impacts the hydro-mechanical response to fluid injection by inducing deviatoric stress variations and rotating the effective stress tensor. These effects promote earlier fault reactivation and induced seismicity at lower pressure buildups and on non-critical fault orientations, highlighting the necessity of accounting for Biot tensor anisotropy in reservoir safety assessments.
本研究提出了一个理论框架，用于根据完整多孔基质和裂隙网络的性质来定量评估裂隙岩体的等效Biot系数张量。结果表明，优势裂隙组的存在会导致各向异性的等效Biot张量，且垂直于裂隙方向的值大于平行方向。这种各向异性通过诱发偏应力变化和旋转有效应力张量，显著影响流体注入的流体-力学响应。这些效应会在较低的……

t: A theoretical framework to formulate and quantify the equivalent anisotropic Biot coefficient tensor of fractured rock masses based on intact matrix and fracture network properties.
基于完整基质和裂隙网络性质，定量评估裂隙岩体等效各向异性Biot系数张量的理论框架。
Synthetic hydro-mechanical modeling scenarios representing fluid injection and pressurization in fractured subsurface reservoirs.

Anisotropy in the Biot tensor induces deviatoric stress variations and rotates effective stress, promoting earlier fault reactivation at lower pressure buildups.

Hydro-mechanical (HM) coupling analysis of reservoir response to fluid injection and pressurization.

sum: This study evaluates how boundary-condition fidelity affects bottom-hole pressure (BHP) and CO2 plume prediction in geological carbon storage. By comparing ten reduced-domain boundary treatments against full-domain reference simulations in homogeneous and heterogeneous reservoirs, the authors demonstrate that conserving corner pore volume is critical. Uniform treatments neglecting corner storage generate large pressure errors (BHP RMSE up to 382 psi) and misrepresent 16-20% of the plume area. In contrast, corner-adjusted scenarios reduce pressure errors and raise plume Intersection over Union (IoU) above 0.94. The gradual modifier with transmissibility correction provides the most consistent performance, achieving BHP NRMSE below 3.7% and plume IoU above 0.97 across both reservoir types.
本研究评估了边界条件保真度对地质碳封存中井底压力（BHP）和二氧化碳羽流预测的影响。通过在均质和非均质储层中对比10种简化区域边界处理方法与全区域参考模拟，研究表明保留角部孔隙体积至关重要。忽视角部储集空间的均匀处理会产生巨大的压力误差（BHP均方根误差高达382 psi），并导致16-20%的羽流……

t: Evaluation of ten reduced-domain boundary treatments (including pore-volume multipliers, transmissibility modifiers, and gradual modifiers) against full-domain reference simulations in homogeneous and heterogeneous reservoirs.
在均质和非均质储层中，对比评估了十种简化区域边界处理方法与全区域参考模拟的效果。
Synthetic homogeneous and heterogeneous reservoir simulation models of geological carbon storage, evaluating bottom-hole pressure and CO2 plume migration.
用于评估井底压力和二氧化碳羽流运移的地质碳封存合成均质及非均质储层模拟模型。

角部调整方案将羽流IoU提升至0.94以上；带传导率修正的渐变修正实现了BHP NRMSE低于3.7%且IoU高于0.9…

sum: This paper establishes a self-consistent analytical model demonstrating that trapped non-wetting liquid phases (oil droplets) in narrow capillary channels can be successfully unpinned via non-resonant, second-order acoustic streaming coupled with background static drive gradients. By expanding hydrodynamic equations to second order, the author determines the critical acoustic wave amplitude required to break capillary pinning thresholds. Incorporating boundary-layer wall effects and bulk thermo-viscous dissipation reveals an optimal operational frequency where the spatial absorption coefficient matches half the inverse distance to the target droplet. This theoretical framework helps optimize downhole acoustic tools for enhanced oil recovery.
本文建立了一个自洽的解析模型，证明了窄毛细管通道中受困的非润湿液相（油滴）可以通过非共振、二阶声流与背景静态驱动梯度的耦合成功解除束缚。通过将流体动力学方程展开至二阶，作者确定了突破毛细管束缚阈值所需的临界声波振幅。结合边界层壁面效应和体热粘性耗散，研究揭示了一个最佳工作频率，即空间吸收系数与到目标……

t: Second-order expansion of hydrodynamic equations to model non-resonant acoustic streaming and determine critical wave amplitudes for unpinning.

Numerical validation of the analytical model and cross-correlation against legacy industrial frequency baselines.
对解析模型进行数值验证，并与传统工业频率基准进行交叉关联。
Derivation of an optimal operational frequency scaling inversely with transmission distance, where the spatial absorption coefficient matches half the inverse distance to the target.
推导出最佳工作频率与传输距离成反比，此时空间吸收系数与目标距离倒数的一半匹配。
The analytical model is constrained to idealized capillary tubes and simplified viscous wall boundaries.
该解析模型受限于理想化的毛细管通道和简化的粘性壁面约束。
Moving away from resonant mechanisms to exploit bulk acoustic-wind force density, establishing an inverse scaling law between optimal frequency and transmission distance.
摆脱了共振机制，利用体声风力密度，建立了最佳频率与传输距离之间的反比比例定律。

kc: Established a self-consistent analytical model for unpinning trapped oil droplets using non-resonant acoustic streaming.
Derived the critical acoustic wave amplitude required to overcome capillary pinning thresholds.

建立了利用非共振声流解除受困油滴束缚的自洽解析模型。

Analytical modeling of thermo-viscous dissipation and boundary-layer wall effects.

sum: This paper presents a spatial-temporal statistical analysis of the relationship between episodic tremor and slip (ETS) and regional seismicity in northern Cascadia from 2006 to 2024. By defining spatial-temporal tremor clusters and merging six earthquake catalogs, the authors evaluate seismicity rates and magnitude distributions in the mid-lower forearc crust and subducting plate. They find that during and shortly after ETS events, M > 2.5 earthquakes near the ETS zone increase slightly to match a standard Gutenberg-Richter (GR) law, whereas inter-ETS periods show fewer M > 2.5 events than predicted by GR. Although these magnitude variations are statistically significant, the overall average occurrence rate remains low (0.8 earthquakes per ETS event), and no temporal variations in daily seismicity rates were detected.
本文对2006至2024年间北卡斯卡迪亚慢地震（ETS）与区域地震活动性之间的时空关联进行了统计分析。作者通过定义震颤的时空聚类并整合六个地震目录，评估了前弧中下地壳及俯冲板块内的地震率和震级分布。研究发现，在ETS期间及之后，邻近M > 2.5地震数量略有增加并符合G-R关系，而ETS间歇期大地震……

t: Spatial-temporal clustering of tremor episodes combined with statistical analysis of merged earthquake catalogs to evaluate Gutenberg-Richter magnitude distributions.
采用震颤事件时空聚类方法，结合合并地震目录的统计分析，评估G-R震级分布规律。
A merged dataset of six earthquake catalogs and tremor records in northern Cascadia spanning from 2006 to 2024.

Very low average earthquake productivity (0.8 earthquakes per ETS event) and no detectable temporal variations in daily seismicity rates.

First long-term (2006-2024) multi-catalog statistical proof of significant earthquake magnitude distribution variations associated with Cascadia ETS cycles.

sum: This study reconstructs the 200-million-year metallogenic history of the Delamerian convergent margin in mainland Australia, a key segment of the East Gondwana paleo-Pacific margin. By integrating geological, geochemical, geochronological, and sulphur isotope evidence, the authors identify four distinct mineralization events spanning from Neoproterozoic orthomagmatic Ni-Cu to Siluro-Devonian intrusion-related Au. The region's diverse mineral potential, described as a 'general store' of strategic resources, was governed by sequential tectonic switching and specific magmatic priming (high hydration, deep-seated fractionation, and elevated oxidation states). This work demonstrates how supercontinent-accretionary orogen interactions control lithospheric architecture and mineral endowment.
本研究重建了澳大利亚大陆Delamerian汇聚边缘2亿年的成矿历史。通过整合地质、地球化学、年代学和硫同位素证据，作者识别出从新元古代正岩浆型镍铜矿到志留-泥盆纪侵入岩相关金矿的四个不同成矿事件。该地区多样化的矿产潜力（被称为战略资源的“杂货铺”）受控于连续的构造转换和特定的岩浆准备作用（高含水量……

Geochemical, geochronological, and isotopic data from the Delamerian convergent margin in mainland Australia.
来自澳大利亚大陆Delamerian汇聚边缘的地质、地球化学、年代学和同位素数据。

Geochemical and geochronological analysis of magmatic suites.

岩浆岩套的地球化学和年代学分析。

sum: This study conducts hydrogen and oxygen isotope and dissolved ion analyses of hot springs, river waters, fumarolic vapor, and hydrothermal waters at Kussharo Caldera, Japan. Strong linear correlations among δ2H, δ18O, Cl−, and SO42− in the Kawayu hot springs indicate mixing between meteoric water and a magmatic end-member. Crucially, the isotopic composition of this magmatic end-member matches simulated values for water derived from the subducting Pacific Plate. This provides direct, compelling evidence that magmatic water originates from the slab, demonstrating that large fluxes of slab-derived water can preserve their original isotopic signatures despite potential rock-water interactions.
本研究对日本屈斜路破火山口及周边的温泉、河水、喷气孔蒸气和热液进行了氢氧同位素及溶解离子分析。川汤温泉中δ2H、δ18O、Cl−和SO42−之间的强线性相关性表明，大气降水与岩浆端元发生了混合。关键是，该岩浆端元的同位素组成与俯冲太平洋板块释放水分的模拟值高度吻合。这提供了岩浆水直接源自俯冲板块的有……

sum: This paper presents acceleration strategies for the planar 3D Implicit Level Set Algorithm (ILSA) to reduce the computational cost of hydraulic fracturing simulations. The authors introduce a unified scheme that consolidates nested loops, apply a matrix splitting approach to the linearized elastohydrodynamic system, and incorporate Anderson acceleration. Across five benchmark cases, the combined techniques achieve an average 4x speedup (up to 11x for sandglass geometry) while maintaining high accuracy, with relative aperture discrepancies below 5%.
本文针对平面三维隐式水平集算法（ILSA）提出了一系列加速策略，以降低水力压裂模拟的计算成本。作者引入了一种合并嵌套循环的统一格式，对线性化弹性流体动力学系统应用了矩阵分裂方法，并结合了安德森加速。在五个基准测试中，这些技术的组合应用实现了平均4倍的加速（在沙漏型几何中高达11倍），同时保持了高精度……

Numerical simulations evaluated across five benchmark cases of hydraulic fracturing, including a sandglass geometry.

sum: This study uses numerical simulations to quantify the viscous and Ohmic dissipation of Earth's inner core translational oscillations (Slichter modes) in the fluid outer core. The authors explore one polar and two equatorial modes split by Earth's rotation, deriving scaling laws for their quality factors. They find that viscous damping is negligible and confined to a thin boundary layer, whereas Ohmic dissipation dominates, yielding decay times of 4 to 16 years. Equatorial modes damp at least twice as fast as the polar mode. The results suggest that Slichter modes can persist for years, meaning their non-detection is likely due to weak excitation rather than rapid damping.
本研究通过数值模拟定量分析了地球外核中液态流体对地核平移振荡（施利希特模式）的粘性和欧姆耗散。作者探讨了受自转分裂的一个极地模式和两个赤道模式，并推导了品质因子的标度律。结果表明，粘性效应微乎其微且局限于边界层，而欧姆耗散占主导，衰减时间为4至16年。赤道模式的衰减速度比极地模式快至少两倍。该研究表……

t: Numerical simulations of viscous and Ohmic dissipation in the rotating fluid outer core to model Slichter modes.
利用旋转流体外核中的粘性和欧姆耗散数值模拟来建立施利希特模式。
Synthetic and simulated data of inner core translational oscillations under various planetary core regimes.
不同行星核状态下内核平移振荡的合成与模拟数据。
Ohmic dissipation dominates Slichter mode damping with decay times of 4–16 years, while viscous effects are negligible.

sum: This paper introduces a principled framework for the zero-shot adaptation of the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to seismic interpretation. Instead of computationally expensive fine-tuning, the authors propose a domain-guided prompting strategy. This approach aligns seismic attributes and visualization choices (such as colormaps) with specific geological targets, and employs a hybrid prompting strategy that combines sparse user-defined point prompts with dense mask prompts derived from SAM's internal feature activations. Evaluated across multiple geological targets and datasets, the framework enhances feature separability and boundary delineation, demonstrating that SAM can achieve competitive seismic segmentation performance in a fully zero-shot setting.

在多种地质目标、地震数据集和属性表征上进行了系统性评估。

分割性能仍然高度依赖于初始地震属性和可视化参数的选择。

tm.why: The paper introduces a zero-shot adaptation framework for the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to perform seismic interpretation and segmentation.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract of the arXiv preprint, as no PDF was available.

sum: This paper evaluates the performance of earthquake early warning (EEW) systems in Guatemala, El Salvador, Nicaragua, and Costa Rica from 2016 to 2024. Developed under the ATTAC project, these independent national systems utilize SeisComP software implementing the Virtual Seismologist (VS) and Finite-Fault Rupture Detector (FinDer) algorithms, supported by 72 strong-motion stations. The VS algorithm achieved 89% accuracy, while combining it with FinDer yielded 77% accuracy due to early false positives. First alerts are typically available 10 seconds after origin time for shallow onshore events, with location and magnitude errors below 30 km and 0.5 units. Alerts are disseminated via a mobile app with over one million users, delivering red alerts within 2–8 seconds of issuance.
本文评估了2016至2024年间危地马拉、萨尔瓦多、尼加拉瓜和哥斯达黎加地震预警（EEW）系统的运行表现。该系统基于ATTAC项目开发，利用SeisComP软件运行VS和FinDer算法，并由72个强震台站提供支持。评估表明，VS算法的独立准确率达89%，结合FinDer后由于早期误报降至77%。对……

t: The system implements the Virtual Seismologist (VS) and Finite-Fault Rupture Detector (FinDer) algorithms within the ETHZ-SED SeisComP software framework.
该系统在ETHZ-SED SeisComP软件框架内实现了虚拟地震学家（VS）和有限断层破裂探测器（FinDer）算法。
Real-time seismic monitoring data from 72 EEW-ready strong-motion stations across Guatemala, El Salvador, Nicaragua, and Costa Rica.
来自危地马拉、萨尔瓦多、尼加拉瓜和哥斯达黎加72个具备预警能力的强震台站的实时地震监测数据。
The VS algorithm achieved 89% accuracy (77% with FinDer), with first alerts available 10 s after origin time and magnitude errors below 0.5.
VS算法实现了89%的准确率（结合FinDer为77%），首个预警在发震后10秒内发出，震级误差低于0.5。
False positives occurred early in the evaluation window when including FinDer, and long-term viability depends on stable governance and funding.
在评估初期引入FinDer时存在误报，且系统的长期生存取决于稳定的治理和持续的资金支持。
First operational multi-national EEW system deployed and evaluated in several low- and middle-income countries using shared real-time data.
首次在多个中低收入国家部署并评估了基于共享实时数据的跨国运行地震预警系统。

kc: First comprehensive evaluation of operational earthquake early warning (EEW) systems across multiple low- and middle-income countries in Central America.
Demonstration of regional consistency in EEW performance through shared real-time seismic data and common system architecture.
Successful deployment of a mobile alerting application reaching over one million users with low-latency delivery (2–8 s).
首次对中美洲多个中低收入国家运行的地震预警（EEW）系统进行全面评估。
通过共享实时地震数据和统一的系统架构，展示了区域内高度一致的预警性能。
成功部署了覆盖超百万用户的移动端预警应用程序，实现了极低延迟（2-8秒）的警报送达。
me: Virtual Seismologist (VS) algorithm for probabilistic seismic early warning.
Finite-Fault Rupture Detector (FinDer) algorithm for line-source rupture characterization.
Integration of real-time data streams within the SeisComP software framework.
用于概率性地震早期预警的虚拟地震学家（VS）算法。
用于线源破裂特征描述的有限断层破裂探测器（FinDer）算法。
在SeisComP软件框架内集成实时数据流。
de: Real-time seismic data from 72 EEW-ready strong-motion stations across Central America.
Performance evaluation of alerts generated between 2016 and 2024, assessing location, magnitude, and latency errors.
来自中美洲72个具备预警能力的强震台站的实时地震数据。
对2016至2024年间生成的预警进行性能评估，分析定位、震级和延迟误差。
li: Lower combined accuracy (77%) when including FinDer due to false positives in Nicaragua and Costa Rica during the early evaluation phase.
Long-term viability is challenged by the need for stable governance, consistent funding, and coordinated public response guidance.
由于评估初期尼加拉瓜和哥斯达黎加出现误报，引入FinDer后的综合准确率较低（77%）。
长期生存能力面临稳定治理、持续资金支持以及协调公众响应指南的挑战。

tm.why: The paper evaluates the performance and implementation of earthquake early warning (EEW) systems in Central America.
The study discusses the national seismic monitoring infrastructures supported by 72 strong-motion stations and shared real-time data.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and public metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: The paper presents Inunda, a GPU-native, differentiable flood inundation solver that solves the 2D shallow water equations using a mass-conservative local-inertial scheme. By leveraging autograd-compatible operators, Inunda enables gradient-based parameter estimation (such as spatially explicit hydraulic conductivity) via reverse-mode automatic differentiation. Tested on Hurricane Harvey, the July 2025 Central Texas flash flood, and a post-fire flash flood in New Mexico, the solver demonstrates high computational efficiency, competitive accuracy against established models, and robust probabilistic forecasting and calibration capabilities.
本文介绍了Inunda，一款基于GPU原生的可微洪水演进求解器。它采用质量守恒的局部惯性格式求解二维浅水方程。由于所有算子均支持自动求导，Inunda可通过反向模式自动微分进行基于梯度的参数估计（如空间显式水力传导度率定）。在哈维飓风、德州闪洪及火灾后闪洪等案例应用中，该求解器展现出极高的计算效率、……

t: A GPU-native, autograd-compatible 2D shallow water equation solver using a mass-conservative local-inertial scheme for differentiable flood modeling.
基于GPU原生和自动求导的二维浅水方程求解器，采用质量守恒的局部惯性格式。
Evaluated using Hurricane Harvey hindcasts, July 2025 Central Texas flash flood ensemble forecasts, and Rio Ruidoso post-fire flash-flood data.
采用哈维飓风后报、德州中部闪洪集合预报及Rio Ruidoso火灾后闪洪数据进行测试。
Matches Hurricane Harvey high-water marks to 0.67 m MAE and achieves a median gage water-level NSE of +0.72.
哈维飓风模拟的高水位标记平均绝对误差为0.67米，中位数纳什效率系数达+0.72。
Requires high-resolution topographic and meteorological input data, and computational scaling is bound to GPU memory limits.
高度依赖高精度地形与气象输入，且计算规模受限于单卡GPU显存容量。
Combines GPU-native speed with full differentiability for end-to-end gradient-based calibration of spatially explicit hydraulic parameters.
将GPU高计算效率与完全可微性结合，实现了空间显式水力参数的端到端梯度校准。

kc: Developed a GPU-native, fully differentiable 2D shallow water equation solver for high-resolution flood modeling.
Enabled spatially explicit parameter calibration (e.g., hydraulic conductivity) using reverse-mode automatic differentiation.
Demonstrated high computational efficiency, running multi-day, million-cell simulations in minutes on a single GPU.
开发了一款GPU原生、完全可微的二维浅水方程求解器，用于高分辨率洪水模拟。
利用反向自动微分实现了空间显式参数（如水力传导度）的梯度校准。
展示了极高的计算效率，在单张GPU上仅需数分钟即可完成数百万网格、历时数天的模拟。
me: Solving 2D shallow water equations using a mass-conservative local-inertial scheme.
GPU-native implementation with autograd-compatible operators for reverse-mode automatic differentiation.
采用质量守恒的局部惯性格式求解二维浅水方程。
基于GPU原生开发，采用支持自动求导的算子以实现反向自动微分。
de: Hindcast of Hurricane Harvey (2017) in Harris County, Texas, comparing water levels against high-water marks and the National Water Model.
Probabilistic forecasting of the July 2025 Central Texas flash flood using an 18-member 1-km precipitation ensemble.
Post-fire flash-flood modeling and soil parameter calibration in the Rio Ruidoso burn scar.
对德克萨斯州哈里斯县2017年哈维飓风进行后报，并将水位与高水位标记及国家水文模型进行对比。
利用18成员、1公里分辨率的降水集合预报对2025年7月德克萨斯州中部闪洪进行概率预测。
对新墨西哥州Rio Ruidoso火烧迹地进行火灾后闪洪模拟及土壤参数反演率定。
li: The performance and accuracy depend heavily on high-resolution digital elevation models and accurate meteorological forcing data.
模型性能和精度在很大程度上依赖于高分辨率数字高程模型和准确的气象驱动数据。

ev.notes: The analysis is based entirely on the provided abstract as no PDF or external search results were available.

sum: This study develops a physical model to investigate whether periodic pore-fluid pressure fluctuations can induce slow slip events (SSEs) on a planar, velocity-weakening fault. By varying the effective normal stress through axisymmetric fluid diffusion, the authors simulate a spectrum of slip behaviors ranging from quasi-periodic SSEs to earthquakes. The simulated SSEs exhibit durations of 3 months to over a year and magnitudes of Mw 5.5–7.5. However, the parameter space yielding SSEs is narrower than in velocity-strengthening fault models, and the model fails to capture the full range of observed subduction zone SSE properties. This suggests that velocity-strengthening faults remain a more robust framework for consistently reproducing observed SSE characteristics under pore-pressure perturbations.
本研究建立了一个物理模型，探讨周期性孔隙流体压力波动是否能在速度弱化断层上诱发慢地震（SSE）。通过轴对称流体扩散改变有效正应力，模拟了从准周期性慢地震到普通地震的多种滑动行为。模拟的慢地震持续时间为3个月至1年以上，矩震级在5.5至7.5之间。然而，产生慢地震的参数空间比速度强化断层模型更窄，且无……

t: Numerical modeling of rate-and-state shear slip on a planar velocity-weakening fault, one-way coupled with axisymmetric pore-fluid pressure diffusion.
在平面速度弱化断层上进行速率-状态摩擦剪切滑动的数值模拟，并与轴对称孔隙流体压力扩散进行单向耦合。
Synthetic modeling scenarios simulating fluid injection, diffusion, and resulting pore-pressure cycles along a planar fault zone.
合成数值模拟方案，模拟沿平面断层带的流体注入、扩散以及由此产生的孔隙压循环。
The model produces SSEs of Mw 5.5–7.5 lasting 3 months to over a year, but within a narrower parameter space than velocity-strengthening models.
模型产生了持续3个月至1年以上、矩震级5.5-7.5的慢地震，但其参数空间窄于速度强化模型。
The model fails to reproduce the full range of observed SSE properties, and the parameter space for SSEs is highly restricted.
该模型无法重现观测到的所有慢地震特征，且产生慢地震的参数空间非常有限。
Evaluates the viability of velocity-weakening faults under cyclic pore-pressure perturbations for generating SSEs, contrasting them with velocity-strengthening models.
评估了循环孔隙压扰动下速度弱化断层产生慢地震的可行性，并与速度强化模型进行了对比。

kc: Developed a physical model of one-way coupled pore-pressure cycles and fluid diffusion on a planar velocity-weakening fault.
Demonstrated a spectrum of slip behaviors from quasi-periodic slow slip events (SSEs) to fast earthquakes.
Showed that velocity-weakening faults have a narrower parameter space for generating SSEs compared to velocity-strengthening faults.
建立了平面速度弱化断层上孔隙压循环与流体扩散单向耦合的物理模型。
展示了从准周期性慢地震（SSE）到快速地震的完整滑动行为谱。
表明与速度强化断层相比，速度弱化断层产生慢地震的参数空间更为狭窄。
me: Numerical modeling of fault slip using rate-and-state friction laws.
One-way coupling of pore-fluid pressure variations to effective normal stress.
Axisymmetric fluid diffusion equation solver along a 2D planar fault.
使用速率-状态摩擦定律对断层滑动进行数值模拟。
将孔隙流体压力变化单向耦合到有效正应力中。
沿二维平面断层求解轴对称流体扩散方程。
de: Synthetic simulations of pore-pressure cycles with fluid injection at the center of a velocity-weakening fault.
Parametric sweep of diffusion rates, injection periods, and frictional parameters to map slip behaviors.
在速度弱化断层中心进行流体注人的孔隙压循环合成数值模拟。
对扩散率、注入周期和摩擦参数进行参数扫描以绘制滑动行为图谱。
li: The model uses one-way coupling, neglecting the feedback of fault slip and dilation on pore-fluid pressure.
The parameter space that successfully generates stable SSEs is highly constrained and narrower than observed in nature.
该模型采用单向耦合，忽略了断层滑动和剪胀对孔隙流体压力的反馈作用。
成功产生稳定慢地震的参数空间非常受限，且窄于自然界实际观测值。

tm.why: The paper models slow slip events (SSEs) and fault slip behaviors under pore-pressure cycles on velocity-weakening faults.
It investigates the spectrum of slip behaviors from slow slip to earthquakes induced by fluid diffusion.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the peer-reviewed abstract from G3 (Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems) as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates lowermost mantle (D") anisotropy beneath Australia using a novel approach that combines array processing and shear-wave splitting measurements of core-traversing seismic phases (SKS, S2KS, and S3KS). By analyzing splitting discrepancies between phase pairs that share similar upper mantle paths but sample different D" regions, the authors detect strong anisotropy at the southwestern edge of the Pacific Large Low-Velocity Province (LLVP), which they attribute to upwelling flow and a potential deep mantle plume. They also identify anisotropy south of Australia associated with high-velocity slab remnants, while finding isotropic or weakly anisotropic D" beneath the Australian continent itself. This highlights diverse geodynamic environments in the deep mantle.
本研究利用结合台阵处理与剪切波分裂测量的新方法，分析了穿过地核并在核幔边界下方反射的地震波（SKS、S2KS和S3KS），以研究澳大利亚下方最下地幔（D"层）的各向异性。通过对比具有相似上地幔路径但采样不同D"区域的波相分裂差异，研究在太平洋大低速省（LLVP）西南边缘检测到强各向异性，并将其归因于……

t: Combining array processing and shear-wave splitting discrepancy measurements applied to core-traversing phases (SKS, S2KS, S3KS) to isolate lowermost mantle anisotropy.
结合台阵处理与剪切波分裂差异测量，利用核心穿透相（SKS、S2KS、S3KS）隔离最下地幔各向异性。
Core-traversing seismic phases (SKS, S2KS, and S3KS) reflecting off the underside of the core-mantle boundary, recorded by seismic arrays in Australia.
由澳大利亚地震台阵记录的、在核幔边界下方反射的核穿透地震波相（SKS、S2KS、S3KS）数据。
Detected strong anisotropy at the southwestern edge of the Pacific LLVP and south of Australia, with isotropic or weakly anisotropic D″ beneath the continent.
在太平洋LLVP西南边缘和澳大利亚以南检测到强各向异性，而大陆下方D″层表现为各向同性或弱各向异性。
The interpretation relies on splitting discrepancies between specific phase pairs, which depend on favorable ray path geometries and coverage.
该方法依赖于特定波相对应分裂差异的识别，这受到射线路径几何形状和覆盖范围的限制。
A novel array-processing and shear-wave splitting discrepancy workflow applied to SKS, S2KS, and S3KS phases to map diverse geodynamic environments in D″.
提出了一种结合台阵处理与SKS、S2KS、S3KS波相分裂差异分析的新工作流，用于精细刻画D″层动力学环境。

kc: Detected strong lowermost mantle anisotropy at the southwestern edge of the Pacific LLVP, indicating a transition to upwelling flow.
Identified seismic anisotropy south of Australia associated with high-velocity anomalies and potential remnant slab material.
Mapped isotropic or weakly anisotropic D" regions beneath the core of the Australian continent.
Demonstrated a novel array-based shear-wave splitting discrepancy method using SKS, S2KS, and S3KS phases.
在太平洋LLVP西南边缘检测到强烈的最下地幔各向异性，指示了向地幔上升流的过渡。
在澳大利亚以南识别出与高速异常及潜在板块残留相关的最下地幔各向异性。
绘制了澳大利亚大陆核心下方表现为各向同性或弱各向异性的D"层区域。
展示了一种利用SKS、S2KS和S3KS波相的、基于台阵的剪切波分裂差异分析新方法。
me: Array processing of core-traversing seismic phases (SKS, S2KS, and S3KS).
Shear-wave splitting measurements and discrepancy analysis between phase pairs sampling different D" regions.
对穿过地核的地震波相（SKS、S2KS和S3KS）进行台阵处理。
剪切波分裂测量，并对采样不同D"区域的波相进行分裂差异分析。
de: Teleseismic waveforms of core-reflected and core-traversing phases (SKS, S2KS, S3KS) recorded by seismic arrays in and around Australia.
由澳大利亚及其周边地震台阵记录的、穿过地核及在核幔边界反射的远震波相（SKS、S2KS、S3KS）波形数据。
li: Resolution of localized anisotropy is limited by the spatial distribution and coverage of SKS, S2KS, and S3KS ray paths.
局部各向异性的分辨率受限于SKS、S2KS和S3KS射线路径的空间分布和覆盖范围。

tm.why: The paper investigates lowermost mantle (D") deformation and flow beneath Australia using shear-wave splitting measurements of core-traversing phases to detect seismic anisotropy.
The study links seismic anisotropy to deep mantle upwellings, the Pacific LLVP edge, and putative remnant slab material in the lowermost mantle.
The authors use a novel approach combining array processing and shear-wave splitting measurements on core-traversing phases.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the peer-reviewed abstract and metadata from Crossref, as the full PDF was not available.

sum: This dataset presents a reconstructed X-ray computed microtomography (XRT) image stack of a water-saturated pumice clast from the 1650 CE submarine eruption of Kolumbo volcano, Greece. The sample was recovered during IODP Expedition 398. The imaging was performed at the Advanced Light Source (LBNL) using 24 keV monochromatic X-rays, achieving a voxel resolution of 0.635 µm. By saturating the connected pore space with water under vacuum, the dataset allows researchers to distinguish between connected (water-filled) and isolated (gas-filled) pore spaces, providing critical microstructural data for volcanic rock physics and eruption dynamics.
该数据集包含1650年希腊Kolumbo海底火山喷发浮石样品的X射线显微断层扫描（XRT）三维重建图像。样品由IODP 398航次获取。实验在劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室先进光源（ALS）进行，空间分辨率达0.635微米。通过在真空下将连通孔隙饱和注水，该数据能够清晰区分连通孔隙（充水）与孤立孔隙（充气）……

t: X-ray computed microtomography (XRT) imaging using 24 keV monochromatic X-rays with a 10x lens to achieve 0.635 µm voxel resolution.
利用24 keV单色X射线和10倍物镜进行显微断层扫描，实现0.635微米体素分辨率。
A reconstructed 3D image stack of a water-saturated pumice clast from the 1650 CE submarine eruption of Kolumbo, Greece.
1650年希腊Kolumbo海底火山喷发中获取的饱和水浮石碎屑三维重建图像堆栈。
High-resolution 3D imaging enabling the distinction between water-filled connected pores and gas-filled isolated pores at 0.635 µm resolution.
获得了高分辨率三维图像，可在0.635微米尺度上区分充水连通孔隙与充气孤立孔隙。
The dataset represents a single sample under static laboratory conditions onshore, rather than in-situ submarine conditions.
该数据集仅代表陆上静态实验室条件下的单一样品，而非原位海底环境。
First sub-micron resolution 3D X-ray microtomography dataset of Kolumbo 1650 CE pumice distinguishing connected and isolated pore spaces via water saturation.
首次通过真空注水区分连通/孤立孔隙，获取了Kolumbo火山浮石的亚微米级三维XRT数据集。

kc: Provides a high-resolution (0.635 µm voxel size) 3D X-ray microtomography dataset of submarine volcanic pumice.
Enables clear differentiation between connected and isolated pore networks by using a water-saturation technique under vacuum.
提供了海底火山浮石的高分辨率（0.635微米体素大小）三维X射线显微断层扫描数据集。
通过真空饱和注水技术，实现了连通孔隙网络与孤立孔隙网络的清晰区分。
me: X-ray computed microtomography (XRT) using 24 keV monochromatic X-rays at the Advanced Light Source (beamline 8.3.2).
Vacuum water-saturation for 24 hours to fill connected pore spaces with liquid water while leaving isolated pores gas-filled.
在先进光源（ALS，线站8.3.2）使用24 keV单色X射线进行显微断层扫描（XRT）。
进行24小时真空饱和注水，使连通孔隙充满液体水，而孤立孔隙保持充气状态。
de: Reconstructed image stack based on 1969 projections collected over 180 degrees of rotation with a 10x lens.
Pumice sample recovered by International Ocean Discovery Program (IODP) Expedition 398 from the 1650 CE Kolumbo eruption.
基于在180度旋转内采集的1969张投影图像（使用10倍物镜）重建的图像堆栈。
由国际大洋发现计划（IODP）398航次获取的1650年Kolumbo火山喷发浮石样品。
li: The dataset is limited to a single pumice clast sample, which may not represent the full heterogeneity of the eruption products.
数据集仅限于单个浮石碎屑样品，可能无法代表喷发产物的完整非均匀性。

tm.why: The dataset contains microtomography images of pumice from the submarine Kolumbo volcano eruption, which is crucial for understanding volcanic processes and physical properties.

ev.notes: The analysis is based entirely on the detailed metadata and abstract provided by Zenodo/OpenAlex, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study derives moment magnitudes (M) and stress drops (Δσ) for 318 well-recorded Australian earthquakes (3.1≤M≤6.6) to investigate their impact on local magnitude (ML) conversions and ground-motion variability. High stress-drop events are shown to yield higher ML values. To reduce between-event ground-motion residuals (τ) relative to ergodic continental-scale models, the author applies k-means unsupervised clustering to group earthquakes by location and stress-drop similarities. This partially nonergodic approach achieves regionalized reductions in τ. Statistical testing validates that differences in stress-drop populations between clusters are often significant, justifying regional ground-motion logic trees that reduce epistemic uncertainty in seismic-hazard models.
本研究推导了澳大利亚大陆318个地震（3.1≤M≤6.6）的矩震级（M）和应力降（Δσ），探讨了其对地方性震级（ML）转换及地震动变率的影响。结果表明高应力降地震具有更高的ML值。为降低相对于遍历性衰减模型的事件间地震动残差（τ），研究采用k-means无监督机器学习算法，基于空间位置和应力降相似性……

t: Fourier spectral analysis is used to resolve source parameters, combined with k-means unsupervised clustering to group earthquakes by location and stress-drop similarities.
利用傅里叶谱分析解析震源参数，并结合k-means无监督聚类算法按位置和应力降相似性进行地震分组。
An updated dataset of 318 well-recorded earthquakes (3.1≤M≤6.6) occurring within the Australian continental crust since 1994.
使用更新后的数据集，包含1994年以来澳大利亚大陆地壳内318个记录良好的地震（3.1≤M≤6.6）。
Stress drop is a first-order variable; incorporating cluster-based corrections yields regionalized reductions in between-event ground-motion residuals (τ).
应力降是首要影响变量；引入基于聚类的校正项可显著降低区域化事件间地震动残差（τ）。
In some regional clusters, differences between stress-drop population means are not statistically significant, indicating overlapping source characteristics.
在某些聚类中，应力降样本均值之间的差异在统计上并不显著，表明存在特征重叠。
Using unsupervised k-means clustering of spatial and source attributes (stress drop) to construct partially nonergodic ground-motion models and logic trees.

引入了基于位置和应力降的k-means聚类方法，建立了区域化、部分非遍历性的地震动模型。
提供了一个统计框架来对不同区域进行归类，用于构建地震危险性逻辑树，从而降低认知不确定性。

Unsupervised machine learning (k-means clustering) to group earthquakes by geographical coordinates and stress-drop attributes.
Statistical hypothesis testing to evaluate the significance of differences between cluster-based stress-drop populations.
Between-event residual analysis of Fourier amplitude spectra relative to ergodic attenuation models.

相对于遍历性衰减模型的傅里叶振幅谱事件间残差分析。

sum: This paper presents a novel methodology that converts written tectonic histories into falsifiable priors on deep petrophysical structure. Instead of traditional joint inversion, the framework uses calibrated robust-Mahalanobis falsification to test candidate geological scenarios against gravity, magnetic, surface-wave, and magnetotelluric data. Applied to the Al Amar suture in the Arabian Shield, the study demonstrates that while individual datasets fail to distinguish a fertile deep corridor from barren alternatives, the combination of all four datasets successfully rejects rival scenarios. The workflow is validated using real observations, including EMAG2v3 magnetics, WGM2012 gravity, and magnetotelluric soundings, providing a clause-level sensitivity analysis back to the geologist.
本文提出了一种将地质构造历史转化为深部物性结构可证伪先验的新方法。该框架不采用传统的联合反演，而是利用校准的鲁棒马氏距离证伪方法，针对重力、磁力、面波和大地电磁数据测试候选地质情景。应用于阿拉伯地盾Al Amar缝合带的结果表明，单一数据集无法区分成矿深部走廊与贫瘠对照组，而四种数据的联合使用成功排……

t: A prior-based joint falsification framework using calibrated robust-Mahalanobis distance to test geological scenarios against multiple forward-modeled geophysical datasets instead of performing traditional inversion.
基于先验的联合证伪框架，利用校准的鲁棒马氏距离测试地质情景，而非传统反演。

Synthetic petrophysical models generated from tectonic priors, validated against EMAG2v3 magnetics, WGM2012 gravity, a published shear-velocity model, and 122 real magnetotelluric soundings in the Arabian Shield.
由构造先验生成的合成物性模型，并利用磁力、重力、剪切波速度及122个实测电磁测深验证。

No single dataset can distinguish the fertile deep corridor from barren alternatives, but the joint integration of gravity, magnetic, surface-wave, and magnetotelluric data successfully rejects all rival scenarios.
单一数据集无法区分成矿深部走廊，但重、磁、面波和电磁数据的联合成功排除了所有竞争情景。
The method is constrained by the completeness of the geologist's written narrative and the simplified nature of the coarse lithospheric generator.
该方法受限于地质学家书面叙述的完整性以及粗糙岩石圈生成器的简化假设。
Using a restricted language model to translate written geological history into quantitative priors, combined with multi-data falsification instead of joint inversion.
利用受限语言模型将书面地质历史转化为定量先验，并结合多数据证伪而非联合反演。

Introduced a joint falsification framework using robust-Mahalanobis distance as an alternative to traditional joint inversion.
Demonstrated that combining gravity, magnetic, surface-wave, and magnetotelluric data successfully discriminates fertile deep corridors in the Arabian Shield.

引入了使用鲁棒马氏距离的联合证伪框架，作为传统联合反演的替代方案。
证明了结合重力、磁力、面波和大地电磁数据能成功鉴别阿拉伯地盾中的成矿深部走廊。

Coarse lithospheric generator for density, shear-velocity, and resistivity fields.

Validation against EMAG2v3 magnetic data and WGM2012 gravity data.

利用EMAG2v3磁力数据和WGM2012重力数据进行验证。

sum: This study presents a dense passive seismic array experiment (82–117 nodes) and Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) acquisitions on the Isunnguata Sermia glacier tongue in West Greenland across spring, summer, and fall. The authors analyze power spectral densities and noise correlation functions, finding that low-frequency seismic power correlates strongly with ice surface velocity, indicating subglacial hydrological control. They retrieve high-quality noise correlations containing Rayleigh, Love, and P-waves, demonstrating their utility for structural imaging. Additionally, they locate numerous microseismic events with high resolution using Matched Field Processing, revealing seasonal spatial patterns. This work highlights the power of dense arrays for high-resolution cryoseismic monitoring.
本文介绍了在西格陵兰Isunnguata Sermia冰川舌部署的密集微型地震台阵（82-117个节点）和分布式光纤声学传感（DAS）观测。研究分析了功率谱密度和噪声相关函数，发现低频地震能量与冰川表面运动速度高度相关，表明冰下水文对冰川动力学具有强控制作用。研究提取了包含瑞利波、勒夫波和P波的高质……

t: Dense passive seismic array and Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) combined with ambient noise interferometry and Matched Field Processing (MFP) for event location.

Seismic data from 82-117 nodes and multi-week surface DAS deployed over a 2.5 km2 area on Isunnguata Sermia glacier, Greenland, during 2023-2024.
在格陵兰冰川2.5平方公里区域内，于2023-2024年部署的82-117个节点及DAS数据。
Low-frequency seismic power correlates with ice velocity; stable noise correlations retrieve Rayleigh, Love, and P waves; microseismic events are located with meter-scale resolution.

sum: This paper introduces a cumulative maximum tensor shear attribute (\gamma_{p,max}) derived from Continuum-Discrete Element Method (CDEM) simulations to model fault zones as finite-width deformation structures rather than discontinuous lines. The attribute is defined from incremental plastic strain and accumulated as a non-decreasing shear-path-length measure. In two dimensions, instantaneous maximum tensor shear corresponds to the radius of the in-plane strain Mohr circle. CDEM examples demonstrate high cumulative shear along modeled fault cores and tips, and lower values across distributed deformation zones. This workflow produces registered mechanical targets and structural models suitable for subsequent synthetic-seismic and machine-learning experiments, though it remains subject to small-strain, constitutive, and spatial-resolution limitations.
本文提出了一种基于连续-非连续单元法（CDEM）数值模拟的累积最大张量剪切属性（\gamma_{p,max}$），将断层带视为有限宽度的变形结构。该属性由增量塑性应变定义，并累积为非递减的剪切路径长度度量。二维情况下，瞬时最大张量剪切对应于面内应变莫尔圆的半径。CDEM示例表明，沿模拟的断层核心和尖……

利用连续-非连续单元法（CDEM）模拟，从增量塑性应变中推导累积最大张量剪切属性。

Derived the component and principal-strain forms of the attribute, clarifying its factor-of-two relation to engineering shear.

Mathematical derivation of instantaneous and cumulative maximum tensor shear in 2D strain space.

二维应变空间中瞬时和累积最大张量剪切的数学推导。

CDEM synthetic models simulating fault cores, tips, and distributed deformation zones.
单调剪切数值示例，用于验证厚度平均累积属性关系。

sum: This study utilizes seismic data from five long-running stations over a 20-year period in Borneo to investigate upper mantle anisotropy. By performing splitting analyses on teleseismic core-mantle-boundary refracted (SKS/SKKS) and local S waves, the authors resolve a two-layer anisotropic structure. The upper lithospheric layer exhibits fast polarization directions parallel to major geological sutures (Kuching and Meratus) in the south and paleocollisional structures in the north, representing inherited tectonic fabrics. The lower asthenospheric layer shows a dominant WNW-ESE fast orientation, consistent with the absolute plate motion of the Sunda plate, though locally deflected by a lithospheric keel beneath eastern Borneo. This study reconciles previous discrepant observations by demonstrating layered anisotropy, highlighting the role of both ancient tectonic accretion and modern mantle flow.
本研究利用婆罗洲5个长期地震台站约20年的观测数据，通过对远震核幔边界折射S波和地方震S波的剪切波分裂分析，系统研究了上地幔双层各向异性结构。结果表明，岩石圈各向异性与主要地质构造密切相关，南部平行于古缝合线，北部记录了古碰撞变形，反映了继承性构造特征；软流圈各向异性呈西西北-东东南走向，与巽他板块……

t: Shear-wave splitting analysis of teleseismic core-mantle-boundary refracted (e.g., SKS) and local S waves recorded over a 20-year period to resolve depth-dependent anisotropic layers.
利用20年长期台站记录的远震核幔边界折射S波和地方震S波进行剪切波分裂分析，解析深部分层各向异性。
Seismic waveform data from five long-running stations in Borneo spanning approximately 20 years, capturing both teleseismic core phases and local shear waves.
婆罗洲5个长期运行地震台站积累的约20年地震波形数据，包含远震核心相和地方震剪切波。

Identification of a two-layer anisotropic system: lithospheric anisotropy parallel to suture zones and paleocollisional strikes, and asthenospheric anisotropy aligned WNW-ESE with Sunda plate motion, locally deflected by an eastern lithospheric keel.
发现双层各向异性：岩石圈各向异性平行于缝合线和古碰撞带；软流圈各向异性呈WNW-ESE向，与巽他板块运动一致，但在东部受…

Reconciles conflicting previous single-layer anisotropy models by demonstrating a distinct two-layer anisotropic structure separating lithospheric tectonic inheritance from asthenospheric mantle flow.

Shear-wave splitting analysis of local S waves to constrain shallower (lithospheric) anisotropy.
Joint interpretation of local and teleseismic splitting to construct a layered anisotropy model.

sum: This Zenodo repository provides teleseismic travel-time pick files (in FMTOMO .ttr format) generated for a seismic tomography study of Macquarie Island. The dataset includes three levels of data processing: completely unfiltered picks, manually filtered picks, and picks that have undergone both manual filtering and minimum-pick filtering (at least 8 picks per event) followed by preliminary tomography filtering. These files are designed for use with the FMTOMO package to image the crustal and lithospheric structure beneath Macquarie Island.
该Zenodo数据库提供了用于麦夸里岛地震断层成像研究的远震走时拾取文件（FMTOMO的.ttr格式）。数据集包含三种处理程度的数据：未过滤的原始拾取、经人工筛选的拾取，以及经过人工筛选、单事件最少8个拾取过滤及初步断层成像过滤后的拾取。这些数据可直接用于FMTOMO软件，以重建麦夸里岛下方的地壳与……

sum: This dataset provides processed teleseismic waveform data from ocean-bottom seismometers (OBS) and land stations deployed at Macquarie Island. The OBS waveforms are denoised using the Day (ZP-21) compliance and tilt noise removal method, filtered between 0.3–2 Hz, and sampled at 20 Hz. The dataset includes cut waveform segments in SeisMem format and adaptive stacked waveforms in tcas format. This high-quality dataset is designed to facilitate high-resolution seismic tomography and structural imaging of the Macquarie Ridge Complex, overcoming the high-noise limitations typical of marine environments.
该数据集提供了部署在麦夸里岛的海底地震仪（OBS）和陆地台站的远震波形数据。OBS波形采用Day（ZP-21）方法进行了顺应性和倾斜去噪，滤波范围为0.3–2 Hz，采样率为20 Hz。数据集包含SeisMem格式的去噪与未去噪波形切片，以及经自适应叠加（tcas）处理后的波形数据。该高质量数据集旨……

sum: This study analyzes a 14-year (2006–2020) SO2 emission rate dataset from Whakaari/White Island, New Zealand, to understand open-vent volcanic processes. The authors identify five degassing phases and a magmatic-hydrothermal duality where high-rate emissions coexist with localized overpressure from matrix sealing. Crucially, the 2019 eruption was preceded by a multi-month baseline increase exceeding the 95th percentile (800 t/day). Wavelet analysis reveals short-term periodicities and longer cycles at ~565 days (linked to regional slow slip) and ~1,275 days (linked to deep reservoir supply and shallow conduit dynamics). This provides a valuable framework for hazard assessment.
本研究分析了新西兰怀特岛14年的SO2排放率数据，划分出五个脱气阶段。研究揭示了岩浆-热液双重性：高排放通道与基质密封导致的局部超压并存。2019年喷发前数月，SO2基线显著升高并超过95%分位数（800吨/天）。小波分析发现~565天（与区域慢滑移相关）和~1275天（与深部供应相关）的周期，为火……

对14年SO2排放率时间序列进行小波分析和基于阈值的基线监测，以识别周期性和喷发前兆。
A 14-year (2006–2020) SO2 emission rate dataset from Whakaari/White Island, New Zealand.

Challenges in resolving short-term noisy fluctuations and establishing direct physical mechanisms for tectonic-volcanic coupling.

首次通过十年尺度的长期SO2周期特征，将火山脱气与区域构造慢滑移事件及深部岩浆库动力学联系起来。

sum: This study presents a new Curie point depth map of Iceland using high-precision aeromagnetic anomaly data and a fractal magnetization model. The estimated Curie depths range from 4 to 30 km, with the shallowest depths beneath the Reykjanes Peninsula and central Iceland. By comparing these depths with 1,026 heat flow measurements and earthquake seismogenic depths, the authors find that the seismogenic base is slightly deeper than the Curie depth. Crucially, the temperature gradient drops from 20–80°C/km in the upper crust (supra-Curie) to 10–35°C/km in the thick lower crust (sub-Curie). This sharp reduction in the lower crustal thermal gradient provides a key constraint for geodynamic models of Iceland's formation and evolution.
本研究利用高精度航空磁异常数据和分形磁化模型，绘制了冰岛的居里点深度图。估算的居里深度在4至30公里之间，其中雷克雅内斯半岛和冰岛中部最浅。通过与1026个热流测量点及地震发震层深度的对比，发现发震层下界略深于居里深度。关键创新点在于，上地壳（居里点以上）温度梯度为20–80°C/km，而厚实的下地……

High-precision aeromagnetic anomaly data, 1,026 heat flow measurement points, and earthquake catalog data in Iceland.
冰岛的高精度航空磁异常数据、1026个热流测量点以及地震目录数据。
Curie depths range from 4 to 30 km; the sub-Curie temperature gradient in the lower crust is 10–35°C/km, much lower than the supra-Curie gradient (20–80°C/km).
居里深度为4-30 km；下地壳温度梯度（10-35°C/km）远低于上地壳（20-80°C/km）。

Revealing a fundamental thermal change with a much-reduced temperature gradient (10–35°C/km) in the thick Icelandic lower crust.
揭示了冰岛厚下地壳中温度梯度显著降低（10–35°C/km）的根本性热结构变化。

sum: This Zenodo repository provides the data and MATLAB codes associated with a study on the stress triggering of supraglacial lake hydro-fracture. The research investigates how stress transfers and triggers hydro-fracture across viscous, viscoelastic, and elastic timescales, which is crucial for understanding Greenland ice sheet drainage dynamics. By sharing the computational tools and datasets, the authors enable the reproduction of their modeling of ice deformation and fracture mechanics under varying temporal scales.
该Zenodo仓库提供了关于超冰湖水力破裂应力触发机制研究的数据和MATLAB代码。该研究探讨了在粘性、粘弹性及弹性时间尺度下，应力如何转移并触发冰川水力破裂，这对于理解格陵兰冰盖的消融与排水动力学至关重要。通过开源计算工具和数据集，作者展示了不同时间尺度下冰川形变与破裂力学的数值模拟方法，促进了冰……

sum: The authors present MEAD-M20, a new P- and S-wave tomographic model of the Middle East and surrounding regions developed using full-waveform inversion (FWI) and the adjoint method. Starting from the global model GLAD-M25, they invert waveforms from 210 regional earthquakes recorded by 1,215 stations over 20 iterations. The model incorporates transverse isotropy in the upper mantle and utilizes a refined crustal mesh to resolve fine-scale structures. MEAD-M20 successfully images local mantle plumes beneath the Arabian Plate, remnants of the Tethys Ocean beneath Eastern Anatolia, and lithospheric-scale low-velocity anomalies associated with the North and East Anatolian faults extending to 200 km depth. This self-consistent model is valuable for seismic wave simulations, earthquake location, and hazard assessment.
本文提出中东地区新型全波形反演层析成像模型MEAD-M20。基于伴随状态法，利用1215个台站的210个区域地震进行20次迭代反演，构建了包含横向各向同性的P波和S波模型。模型揭示了阿拉伯板块下方的局部地幔柱、特提斯洋残留，以及安纳托利亚断裂带下方延伸至200公里的低速异常，为地震模拟提供了高精度三……

t: Full-waveform inversion using 3D wavefield simulations and the adjoint method, incorporating multitaper traveltime measurements of body and surface waves.
基于三维波场模拟和伴随状态法的全波形反演，结合了体波和面波的多窗谱旅行时测量。
Waveforms from 210 regional earthquakes recorded by 1,215 permanent and temporary stations, starting from the global model GLAD-M25.
1215个固定和临时台站记录的210个区域地震波形，以全球模型GLAD-M25为起点。
MEAD-M20 resolves local mantle plumes, Tethys remnants beneath Eastern Anatolia, and lithospheric-scale low-velocity anomalies under the North and East Anatolian faults down to 200 km.
MEAD-M20解析了局部地幔柱、东安纳托利亚下方的特提斯残留，以及安纳托利亚断裂带下方深达200公里的岩石圈尺度低速异…

kc: Developed MEAD-M20, a high-resolution P- and S-wave tomographic model of the Middle East using FWI.
Incorporated transverse isotropy in the upper mantle and refined the crustal mesh to better sample crustal structures.

sum: This paper presents EKI-GRFs-FWI, a novel uncertainty-aware frequency-domain acoustic full waveform inversion (FWI) framework. To overcome the high computational costs of traditional Monte Carlo-based Bayesian uncertainty quantification, the authors integrate Gaussian random fields (GRFs) with ensemble Kalman inversion (EKI). EKI provides a derivative-free, highly parallelizable inversion scheme with an effective stopping criterion, while GRFs incorporate spatial correlation prior knowledge to generate physically feasible initial ensembles. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method reconstructs accurate velocity models and provides reliable, computationally efficient uncertainty estimates, making it promising for large-scale seismic inverse problems.

sum: This paper presents an attention-based deep learning method for continuous-interval seismic phase picking. By modifying PhaseNet to include LSTM units in the encoder, parallel attention in skip connections, and a convolutional block attention module in the decoder, the authors enhance feature extraction. They introduce interval labels (P-wave segment from P to S arrival, S-wave segment from S to P+3(S-P)) to improve picking robustness. Trained on STEAD and tested across STEAD, INSTANCE, and Texas Earthquake Dataset, the model achieves superior F1-scores (e.g., S-wave F1 of 0.980 on STEAD) compared to PhaseNet, SEA, and EQTransformer. It also demonstrates resilience to single-component data loss, though performance degrades with multi-component loss.

sum: This paper presents a novel uncertainty quantification framework for Bayesian full-waveform inversion (FWI) using underdamped Langevin Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). To address the slow convergence and high computational cost of traditional MCMC in high-dimensional spaces, the authors incorporate momentum and inertia via underdamped Langevin dynamics. They implement and compare two splitting schemes—Strang splitting and OBABO splitting—to discretize the stochastic differential equations, reducing discretization errors and enhancing stability. Numerical experiments on two synthetic examples demonstrate that both schemes effectively explore the posterior distribution to estimate means, variances, and marginal densities. Strang splitting shows slightly faster convergence and lower computational overhead. The method provides robust uncertainty estimates and is highly insensitive to the initial model.

sum: This paper presents a community model designed for integrated studies of trans-crustal magmatic systems (TCMS). By synthesizing multi-disciplinary geophysical and petrological datasets—such as seismic velocity (Vp, Vs), electrical resistivity from magnetotellurics, and petrological constraints—the model provides a unified framework to investigate magma storage, transport, and crystallization processes. The community model facilitates collaborative research by offering standardized, accessible 3D grids of physical properties, enabling more consistent geodynamic simulations and hazard assessments. The primary novelty lies in the systematic integration of disparate physical parameters into a single, open-access reference model for volcanic systems.

sum: This study utilizes receiver-function imaging combined with mineral physics modeling to perform a joint inversion of the mantle transition zone (MTZ) beneath Northeast China. The authors map the morphology and thermochemical state of the stagnant Pacific slab, identifying a drop-shaped penetration segment and a lens-shaped weakened zone. They find that the upper MTZ above the slab is enriched in basalt (~0.4) and water (~0.38 wt%) at near-ambient temperatures. The peak upwelling fluxes concentrate above the slab lens and edge, spatially correlating with two major volcanic clusters. This provides a novel mechanism where slab-scale heterogeneity drives focused, water-driven upwelling, controlling intraplate volcanism and crustal recycling.

sum: This study applies three-dimensional magnetotelluric (MT) inversion to 63 broadband sites in the Southeast Anatolian Orogenic Belt to image sub-basalt sedimentary structures. The resulting 3D resistivity model successfully delineates a ~3 km thick sedimentary sequence beneath the highly resistive Karacadağ Volcanic Complex. It identifies the low-resistivity Kastel Formation as a regional cap rock and the moderately resistive Mardin Group carbonates as potential reservoir units. The gently varying resistivity geometries suggest fold-and-thrust-related structural closures. This work demonstrates the utility of 3D MT inversion as an exploration tool in volcanic-covered areas where traditional seismic imaging is severely limited.

sum: This study evaluates a recently developed 3D crustal velocity model for northern Israel (Be3D) against a 1D regional model (Gitt1D) using numerical wavefield simulations of 18 earthquakes (Mw 3.0–4.5). Synthetic seismograms are compared with Israel Seismic Network observations in the 0.1–0.5 Hz range. The 3D model shows superior performance, with waveform cross-correlation time lags concentrated around zero and significantly reduced spectral misfit across all components. However, the model underestimates spectral amplitudes in narrow sedimentary basins (e.g., Kinneret-Kinarot and Hula) due to unresolved near-surface low-velocity zones, highlighting areas for future refinement.

sum: This paper presents Argus, a sparse-label machine-learning workflow designed to address the data-volume and label-scarcity challenges in passive distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) monitoring of geological CO2 storage. Argus uses a deterministic front end to extract trigger objects, representing them with 67 interpretable time-channel features. A retrieval-first machine-learning layer then ranks these triggers based on similarity to a small seed catalogue of confirmed events. An iterative human-in-the-loop process incorporates local supervised noise-rejection gates. Applied to 120 days of passive DAS data (23 TB, 14.14 million triggers) from the CO2CRC Otway Stage 4 project, Argus successfully expanded a 39-event seed catalogue to 631 analyst-reviewed events. The workflow demonstrates high complementarity with template matching, recovering additional induced events and providing a reproducible, auditable event inventory suitable for CO2 storage assurance.

sum: This Zenodo dataset presents global geothermal heat flow (GHF) predictions generated using machine learning, accompanied by comprehensive uncertainty estimates. Specifically, it includes model uncertainty, spatial uncertainty, and total prediction uncertainty. Designed to complement an associated publication on optimizing feature selection for GHF prediction, this dataset serves as a valuable resource for geodynamic modeling, lithospheric studies, and geothermal resource assessment by providing both predicted values and their reliability metrics.

sum: This paper proposes a deep-learning-based matching-filtering framework for elastic full waveform inversion (EFWI) to address cycle skipping and modeling errors. A lightweight neural network is trained to learn adaptive, data-driven matching filters that map synthetic elastic wavefields to observed data, absorbing phase, amplitude, and dispersion discrepancies. These filters are optimized jointly with elastic parameters within an automatic differentiation (AD) framework, enabling seamless gradient propagation. Numerical experiments on synthetic elastic models and field data demonstrate that this approach significantly reduces cycle skipping and improves the recovery of P- and S-wave velocities compared to conventional EFWI, especially with strongly biased initial models. The novelty lies in using a neural network to learn adaptive matching filters optimized jointly with physical parameters via AD, providing a robust, physically interpretable pathway for EFWI under realistic uncertainties.
