sum: This study presents a new suite of simulation-based scenario ShakeMaps for large-magnitude (Mw 6.5–7.5) crustal earthquakes on the Seattle, Tacoma, and southern Whidbey Island faults in Washington, USA. To overcome the limitations of empirical ground-motion models (GMMs) in complex geological settings, the authors combine low-frequency (<1 Hz) deterministic 3D wave propagation simulations with high-frequency (1–10 Hz) stochastic seismograms. The simulated ground motions are corrected for minimum shear-wave velocity and nonlinear site response. To extend coverage beyond the simulation domain, GMM-based estimates are scaled using amplification patterns from the simulations. The resulting ShakeMaps highlight the profound influence of deep, interconnected basin structures on ground shaking, demonstrating the necessity of incorporating 3D crustal complexity into regional seismic hazard assessments.
本研究针对华盛顿州西雅图等断层Mw 6.5–7.5地震，构建了基于模拟的情景ShakeMap。方法结合低频三维确定性模拟与高频随机地震图，并修正了场地响应。利用模拟放大系数缩放经验模型，将地图覆盖延伸至模拟区外。结果表明深部盆地结构对地动有显著放大作用，强调了三维地壳结构在区域灾害评估中的重要性。

tm.why: The paper develops simulation-based scenario ShakeMaps to characterize ground shaking and seismic hazard from large crustal earthquakes.
The ShakeMaps are developed using results from 3D wave propagation simulations that incorporate realistic rupture geometries and regional 3D velocity models.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the abstract and public metadata.

sum: This study presents a comprehensive prospective evaluation of 27 earthquake forecasting models operated in California between 2007 and 2018 under the Collaboratory for the Study of Earthquake Predictability (CSEP). Evaluating 51,625 next-day forecasts against 597 observed Mw >= 3.95 earthquakes, the authors find that 95% of the models are consistent with observed earthquake numbers and magnitudes, while only about two-thirds (66%) match spatial locations. Select operational-type models show sustained consistency, providing critical benchmarking and recommendations for global operational earthquake forecasting systems.
本研究对加州CSEP项目在2007-2018年间运行的27个地震预测模型进行了前瞻性评估。通过将5万多个次日预测与597个实际Mw>=3.95地震对比，发现约95%的模型在数量和震级上与观测一致，但仅三分之二在空间位置上一致。部分业务化模型表现出持续一致性，为全球地震预测系统提供了重要基准。

t: Prospective statistical testing of 27 earthquake forecasting models using community-vetted likelihood-based consistency tests for rate, spatial distribution, and magnitude.
使用社区认可的基于似然度的一致性检验方法，对27个地震预测模型的频率、空间和震级进行前瞻性统计测试。
A dataset of 51,625 next-day Mw >= 3.95 seismicity forecasts and 597 observed Mw >= 3.95 earthquakes in California from 2007 to 2018.
包含2007至2018年间加州51,625个次日Mw >= 3.95地震预测及597个实际地震的观测数据集。
Approximately 95% of models were consistent with observed earthquake numbers and magnitudes, while only two-thirds (66%) were consistent with spatial locations.
约95%的模型在地震数量和震级上与观测一致，但仅有约三分之二（66%）在空间位置上保持一致。
The analysis is restricted to Mw >= 3.95 earthquakes over an 11-year prospective window, potentially limiting resolution for larger or smaller events.
分析仅限于11年窗口期内的Mw >= 3.95地震，对更大或更小震级事件的评估分辨率有限。
First comprehensive, decadal-scale prospective evaluation of operational-type earthquake forecasting models in California using rigorous CSEP testing protocols.
首次利用严格的CSEP测试协议，对加州业务化地震预测模型进行十年尺度的全面前瞻性评估。

kc: Comprehensive prospective evaluation of 27 earthquake forecasting models in California over an 11-year period.
Statistical benchmarking of 51,625 next-day forecasts against 597 observed Mw >= 3.95 earthquakes.
Identification of spatial location as the primary source of inconsistency in one-third of the evaluated models.
对加利福尼亚州11年间运行的27个地震预测模型进行了全面的前瞻性评估。
将51,625个次日预测与597个实际发生的Mw >= 3.95地震进行了统计基准测试。
指出空间位置预测是导致三分之一评估模型出现不一致的主要原因。
me: Prospective testing using community-vetted statistical methods within the CSEP framework.
Likelihood-based consistency tests for earthquake number, spatial location, and magnitude distribution.
在CSEP框架内使用社区认可的统计方法进行前瞻性测试。
针对地震数量、空间位置和震级分布进行基于似然度的一致性检验。

Observational dataset of 597 Mw >= 3.95 earthquakes in California during the same decadal period.
2007年8月至2018年8月期间在加州生成的51,625个次日Mw >= 3.95地震活动性预测。
同期加利福尼亚州发生的597个Mw >= 3.95地震的观测数据集。

Performance is evaluated on a decadal scale, which may not fully capture longer-term evolutionary changes in seismicity.
评估仅限于Mw >= 3.95事件，对更小或极罕见的大地震约束较少。
评估基于十年尺度，可能无法完全捕捉地震活动性更长期的演化变化。

tm.why: The paper evaluates prospective earthquake forecasting models in California, which is a core component of seismic hazard assessment and operational earthquake forecasting.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based entirely on the peer-reviewed abstract and metadata from Nature Communications.

sum: This paper addresses the long-standing contradiction between low lithosphere-asthenosphere effective friction (0.01-0.03) and high laboratory rock friction (0.6-0.85). The author proposes the Interface Selection Principle, where the system selects the minimum vertical interface as the sliding plane, making macroscopic friction thickness-dependent. The reduction is dominated by distributed creep shear (80-90%), with a secondary contribution from trace-melt weakening (10-20%). Analytical formulas are derived relating effective friction to creep thickness and melt fraction, redefining Byerlee's law as a melt-free baseline.
本研究解决了岩石圈-软流圈低有效摩擦系数（0.01-0.03）与实验室拜尔利定律高摩擦系数（0.6-0.85）之间的长期矛盾。作者提出了“界面选择原理”，认为系统选择最小垂直界面作为滑动面，使宏观摩擦成为与厚度相关的涌现属性。分布式蠕变剪切主导了80-90%的摩擦降低，而微量熔体弱化贡献了其余10-……

t: Analytical derivation of effective friction coefficient based on the Interface Selection Principle, distributed creep shear, and trace-melt weakening formulas.
基于界面选择原理、分布式蠕变剪切和微量熔体弱化公式解析推导有效摩擦系数。
Standard mantle parameters used for theoretical validation of the derived equations.
用于对所推导公式进行理论验证的标准地幔参数。
Derivation of an effective friction of ~0.0067 at a creep thickness of ~366 m, explaining the low friction observed in geodynamic inversions.
在约366米蠕变厚度下推导出约0.0067的有效摩擦，解释了地球动力学反演中的低摩擦。
Simplified analytical assumptions and reliance on standard mantle parameters without direct regional calibration.
简化的解析假设以及对标准地幔参数的依赖，缺乏直接的区域校准。
Formulating macroscopic friction as a thickness-dependent emergent property rather than a fixed material constant, redefining Byerlee's law.
将宏观摩擦公式化为与厚度相关的涌现属性，而非固定的材料常数，重新定义了拜尔利定律。

kc: Proposes the Interface Selection Principle to explain emergent macroscopic friction.
Derives a core creep friction relation showing effective friction inversely scales with creep thickness.
Formulates a secondary trace-melt weakening model via melt-film contact replacement.
Reconciles the discrepancy between geodynamic inversions and laboratory rock friction measurements.
提出界面选择原理以解释涌现的宏观摩擦行为。
推导了核心蠕变摩擦关系，表明有效摩擦与蠕变厚度成反比。
构建了通过熔体薄膜接触替代的次要微量熔体弱化模型。
调和了地球动力学反演与实验室岩石摩擦测量之间的差异。
me: Theoretical derivation of effective friction coefficient relations.
Analytical modeling of distributed creep shear and trace-melt weakening mechanisms.
有效摩擦系数关系的理论推导。
分布式蠕变剪切和微量熔体弱化机制的解析建模。
de: Standard mantle parameters used to validate the analytical model (yielding effective friction of ~0.0067 at ~366 m creep thickness).
使用标准地幔参数验证解析模型（在约366米蠕变厚度下产生约0.0067的有效摩擦）。
li: The model relies on simplified analytical formulations and standard mantle parameters which may vary regionally.
Lack of direct observational or experimental validation of the derived thickness-dependent scaling in situ.
该模型依赖于简化的解析公式和标准地幔参数，这些参数可能存在区域差异。
缺乏对推导出的厚度相关标度关系的直接原位观测或实验验证。

tm.why: The paper models the effective friction coefficient of the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary using geodynamic parameters.
The paper addresses fundamental rock friction laws, Byerlee's law, and megathrust friction mechanisms.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract from ESS Open Archive.

sum: This paper presents a novel ray-tracing method for layered dissipative anisotropic media by integrating a g*-Hamiltonian-based formulation (MEV) into a shortest-path-based ray-tracing algorithm. The authors evaluate three kernels for computing complex energy velocities: original complex energy velocity (OEV), conjugate real ray tracing (C-RRT), and the proposed MEV. While all three kernels perform consistently for qSH and qP waves, OEV suffers from numerical instability and unphysical attenuation in qSV modeling, and C-RRT yields significant errors, including non-physical negative attenuation. In contrast, the MEV-driven shortest-path ray tracing demonstrates superior computational stability and accuracy for first-arrival modeling in complex, attenuating, and anisotropic geological structures.
本文提出了一种适用于分层耗散各向异性介质的新型射线追踪方法，将基于g*-哈密顿量的公式（MEV）融入到最短路径射线追踪算法中。作者对比了三种计算复能量速度的核函数：原始复能量速度（OEV）、共轭实射线追踪（C-RRT）和MEV。结果表明，三种方法在qSH和qP波上表现一致，但OEV在qSV建模中会出……

t: Integrates a g*-Hamiltonian-based formulation into a shortest-path ray-tracing algorithm to compute complex energy velocities, ray velocities, and quality factors.
将基于g*-哈密顿量的公式融入最短路径射线追踪算法中，用以计算复能量速度、射线速度和品质因子。
Synthetic layered models exhibiting both geological/rheological discontinuities and directionally dependent attenuation (anisotropy and dissipation).
具有地质/流变学不连续性以及方向相关衰减（各向异性和耗散）的合成层状模型。
The MEV kernel provides the most stable first-arrival behavior, whereas OEV causes instabilities in qSV waves and C-RRT yields non-physical negative attenuation.
MEV核提供了最稳定的初至波行为，而OEV在qSV波中引起不稳定，C-RRT产生非物理负衰减。
The algorithm's performance and computational efficiency have not yet been demonstrated on large-scale 3D field datasets.
该算法在大规模三维实际野外数据集上的性能和计算效率尚未得到验证。
First incorporation of the g*-Hamiltonian formulation into shortest-path ray tracing to resolve instabilities in dissipative anisotropic media.
首次将g*-哈密顿量公式引入最短路径射线追踪，解决了耗散各向异性介质中的数值不稳定问题。

kc: Developed a novel shortest-path ray-tracing algorithm driven by a g*-Hamiltonian formulation for dissipative anisotropic media.
Compared three different complex energy velocity kernels (OEV, C-RRT, MEV) and analyzed their numerical stability.
Demonstrated that the MEV kernel successfully mitigates numerical instabilities and unphysical attenuation in qSV wave modeling.
开发了一种由g*-哈密顿量公式驱动的适用于耗散各向异性介质的新型最短路径射线追踪算法。
对比了三种不同的复能量速度核函数（OEV、C-RRT、MEV）并分析了它们的数值稳定性。
证明了MEV核函数成功缓解了qSV波建模中的数值不稳定性和非物理衰减问题。

g*-Hamiltonian formulation (Modified Energy Velocity, MEV).
Complex energy velocity calculation kernels (OEV, C-RRT, MEV).
最短路径射线追踪算法。
g*-哈密顿量公式（改进能量速度，MEV）。
复能量速度计算核函数（OEV、C-RRT、MEV）。

Comparison of traveltimes, ray paths, and ray quality factors for qP, qSH, and qSV waves.
在分层耗散各向异性介质中进行数值模拟和合成测试。
对比qP、qSH和qSV波的走时、射线路径和射线品质因子。

该方法主要在合成层状模型上进行了测试，仍需在复杂的实际三维野外数据集上进行验证。

tm.why: The paper develops a modified Hamiltonian-driven shortest-path ray-tracing algorithm for wave propagation modeling.
The ray-tracing algorithm is specifically designed for and tested in anisotropic media.
The study addresses wave propagation and energy dissipation (attenuation) in dissipative media.

sum: AlpRA25 is a newly released 3D seismic model of the Alps, providing absolute isotropic shear-wave velocity (Vs), polarized shear-wave velocities (Vsh, Vsv), relative velocity perturbations, and radial anisotropy (xi) for both the crust and mantle down to 250 km depth. Formatted in NetCDF4, this dataset enables detailed investigations into the Alpine collision, lithospheric structure, and mantle dynamics. It represents a unified, high-resolution reference model for geodynamic and seismological studies in the European Alps.
AlpRA25是针对阿尔卑斯地区发布的三维地震模型，提供了地壳和地幔（深达250公里）的绝对各向同性剪切波速度（Vs）、偏振剪切波速度（Vsh、Vsv）、相对速度扰动以及径向各向异性参数（xi）。该模型采用NetCDF4格式，将地壳与地幔域统一在单个文件中，旨在为研究阿尔卑斯碰撞带、岩石圈结构及地幔……

t: 3D tomographic inversion resolving absolute shear-wave velocities and radial anisotropy parameters.
通过三维断层成像反演解析绝对剪切波速度和径向各向异性参数。
A 3D NetCDF4 grid (AlpRA25.nc) covering the Alps with 110x64x251 nodes down to 250 km depth.
覆盖阿尔卑斯地区、深达250公里的三维NetCDF4网格数据集（AlpRA25.nc）。
A unified 3D model of isotropic and polarized shear-wave velocities and radial anisotropy for the Alpine crust and mantle.
提供了阿尔卑斯地壳和地幔统一的各向同性及偏振剪切波速度与径向各向异性三维模型。
Model resolution is constrained by the underlying seismic station distribution and frequency bands used.
模型分辨率受限于底层地震台站分布及所使用的频段。
Provides a unified, publicly available 3D radial anisotropy model integrating both crustal and mantle domains for the Alps.
提供了一个统一的、开源的、整合了阿尔卑斯地壳与地幔域的三维径向各向异性模型。

kc: Provides AlpRA25, a unified 3D radial anisotropy and shear-wave velocity model of the Alps down to 250 km depth.
Delivers absolute velocities (Vs, Vsh, Vsv) and relative perturbations in a single, accessible NetCDF4 file.
提供了AlpRA25，一个深达250公里的统一阿尔卑斯三维径向各向异性和剪切波速度模型。
在单个易于访问的NetCDF4文件中提供了绝对速度（Vs、Vsh、Vsv）和相对扰动数据。

对地震数据进行三维断层成像反演，以解析跨地壳和地幔域的径向各向异性和剪切波速度。
de: The dataset consists of a 3D grid (AlpRA25.nc) with dimensions of 110 longitude points, 64 latitude points, and 251 depth points.
该数据集由一个三维网格（AlpRA25.nc）组成，包含110个经度点、64个纬度点和251个深度点。

tm.why: The paper presents AlpRA25, a 3D seismic radial anisotropy model of the Alps.
The dataset provides 3D tomographic grids of absolute and relative shear-wave velocity perturbations.
The model covers both crustal and mantle domains down to 250 km depth to image the Alpine collision.

sum: This paper proposes a novel dynamic leveling mechanism to explain the anomalous million-year flatness of Japan's Kanto Basin. Defying compressional tectonics, the model integrates the stress-shielding of the rigid Kanto Fragment (an embedded Pacific slab) with episodic Mw 8-class deep earthquakes. These deep events trigger forced fluidization, lateral flow, and differential consolidation within the 3–4 km thick sedimentary sequence. This earthquake-driven process resets tectonic topographic irregularities, acting as a natural leveling engine. The study reframes the geomorphic evolution of the Kanto Basin from a static depositional environment to a highly dynamic, seismically driven system, with significant implications for regional seismic hazard assessments.
本文提出动态平准化机制，解释日本关东盆地百万年来的异常平坦。该模型结合了关东板块碎片的应力屏蔽效应与周期性Mw 8级深震。深震引发3-4 km厚沉积层的强制流体化、侧向流动与差异固结，消除了构造起伏。研究将盆地地貌演化从静态沉积重塑为地震驱动的动态系统，对东京圈地震灾害评估有重要意义。

t: Conceptual modeling integrating GNSS-derived rigid-body motion with geotechnical principles of liquefaction, lateral spreading, and differential consolidation.
结合GPS刚体运动与液化、侧向扩展及差异固结等土力学原理的综合概念建模。
GNSS-derived rigid-body motion data of the Kanto Basin and geotechnical parameters of the 3-4 km thick sedimentary sequence.
关东盆地的GNSS刚体运动数据以及3-4千米厚沉积序列的岩土工程参数。
A unified dynamic leveling model showing that episodic Mw 8 deep earthquakes periodically fluidize sediments to reset tectonic topographic irregularities.
构建了统一模型，表明周期性Mw 8级深震引发沉积物液化并消除地形起伏。
The model is primarily conceptual and relies on simplified geotechnical assumptions regarding basin-scale fluidization and lateral flow.
模型主要为概念性，在盆地级流体化和侧向流动上依赖简化的力学假设。
Links deep slab tectonics (Kanto Fragment) and deep earthquakes directly to shallow basin-scale geomorphology and long-term planar stability.
首次将深部板块构造（关东碎片）及深震与浅表盆地地貌的长期平坦性联系起来。

kc: Proposes the 'dynamic leveling' concept to explain the long-term flatness of the Kanto Basin.
Links deep tectonic structures (Kanto Fragment) and deep Mw 8 earthquakes to surface geomorphology.
Integrates geodetic (GNSS) observations with geotechnical principles of sediment fluidization.
提出了“动态平准化”概念，用以解释关东盆地的长期平坦性。
将深部构造结构（关东碎片）及Mw 8级深震与地表地貌演化联系起来。
结合了大地测量（GNSS）观测与沉积物流体化的岩土工程原理。
me: Conceptual geodynamic and geotechnical modeling.
Integration of GNSS-derived rigid-body motion analysis.
Application of soil mechanics (liquefaction, lateral spreading, differential consolidation) to basin-scale processes.
概念性地球动力学与岩土工程建模。
整合基于GNSS的刚体运动分析。
将土力学（液化、侧向扩展、差异固结）应用于盆地级演化过程。

Geotechnical and stratigraphic data of the 3-4 km thick unconsolidated sedimentary sequence.
关东盆地的GNSS大地测量数据。

Relies on simplified assumptions of lateral flow governed by gravitational potential gradients.

依赖于重力势能梯度控制侧向流动的简化假设。

tm.why: The paper models the geodynamic evolution of the Kanto Basin and its interaction with the deep Kanto Fragment slab.
It links deep Mw 8 earthquakes and geotechnical fluidization/liquefaction to basin-scale processes with hazard implications.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analyzed based on the EarthArXiv abstract and online metadata.

sum: This study integrates field mapping, microstructural analysis, and anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS) to reconstruct the deformation history of the Lago della Vacca crystal mush (Adamello Batholith, Italy). The authors show that the body deformed as a highly crystalline mush during a submagmatic stage. AMS records a composite fabric from the superposition of feldspar alignment, micro-shear zones, and melt segregation. Tensor-mixing models confirm that high magnetic anisotropy results from subfabric interference. The results reveal a rheological transition: the pluton core records flow heterogeneity, while marginal domains record progressive flattening due to horizontal compaction from radial expansion.
本研究结合野外填图、微观结构和磁化率各向异性（AMS）分析，重建了意大利一晶粥体的变形历史。该岩体在亚岩浆阶段作为高结晶度晶粥体变形。AMS记录了长石定向、微剪切带和熔体偏析叠加的复合构造。张量混合模型证实高磁各向异性源于子构造干扰。空间变化揭示了流变学转变：岩体核心呈非均匀流动，边缘呈水平压实。

t: Integration of field mapping, microstructural analysis, and anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS) measurements combined with conceptual tensor-mixing models.
结合野外填图、微观结构分析、磁化率各向异性（AMS）测量以及概念性张量混合模型。
Rock samples and field observations from the Lago della Vacca crystal mush within the Adamello Batholith, Italy.
采集自意大利Adamello岩基Lago della Vacca晶粥体的岩石样品和野外地质观测数据。
Identification of a rheological transition from flow heterogeneity in the pluton core to progressive flattening and horizontal compaction in marginal domains.
识别出从岩体核心的流动非均匀性到边缘区域渐进扁平化和水平压实的流变学转变。
Cryptic and composite magnetic fabrics require detailed microstructural context to resolve interference between multiple subfabrics.
隐蔽且复合的磁构造需要详细的微观结构背景来解析多个子构造之间的干扰。
Using tensor-mixing models to resolve cryptic, polyphase deformation and subfabric interference in dynamic crystal mush systems.
利用张量混合模型解析动态晶粥系统中隐蔽的多阶段变形和子构造干扰。

kc: Reconstructed the polyphase deformation and emplacement history of the Lago della Vacca crystal mush.
Demonstrated the use of tensor-mixing models to explain complex magnetic fabrics resulting from subfabric interference.
Identified a systematic rheological transition from intrusive flow in the core to horizontal compaction at the margins.
重建了Lago della Vacca晶粥体的多阶段变形与侵入历史。
展示了利用张量混合模型解释由子构造干扰产生的复杂磁构造的方法。
识别出从岩体核心的侵入流动到边缘水平压实的系统性流变学转变。
me: Anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS) analysis to measure magnetic fabrics.
Microstructural analysis of feldspar alignment, micro-shear zones, and melt segregation.
Conceptual tensor-mixing modeling to simulate subfabric interference.
利用磁化率各向异性（AMS）分析测量磁构造。
对长石定向、微剪切带和熔体偏析进行微观结构分析。

de: Field mapping and sample collection from the Lago della Vacca intrusion (Adamello Batholith, Italy).
Laboratory measurements of magnetic susceptibility and anisotropy on rock samples.
对意大利Adamello岩基Lago della Vacca侵入体进行野外填图和样品采集。

sum: This study investigates the mechanisms of earthquake rupture propagation and transfer into the sediment-filled Amik Basin, Türkiye, a key tectonic depression along the East Anatolian Fault Zone. Utilizing pre-seismic Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) observations and surface-deformation data, the authors analyze the strain accumulation and fault behavior prior to major seismic events (such as the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes). The paper provides insights into how thick sediment cover and basin geometry influence rupture termination, bypass, or transfer, offering critical constraints on seismic hazard assessment in complex strike-slip basin settings.

sum: This study utilizes seismic interferometry applied to Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data to map coseismic velocity changes associated with an M4.1 earthquake 40 km away from Sakurajima volcano, Japan. By stacking ambient noise cross-correlation functions (CCFs) across numerous channel pairs, the authors achieved a high temporal resolution of 30 minutes. They observed seismic velocity decreases of up to 1.0% in the 2-3 Hz band, particularly in sedimentary or old lava regions characterized by low S-wave velocity. Despite low peak ground velocities (0.16 cm/s), significant velocity reductions and subsequent recovery (lasting ~12 hours) were successfully tracked. The novelty lies in demonstrating that stacking dense DAS channel pairs can significantly boost the signal-to-noise ratio, enabling high-resolution temporal and spatial monitoring of subtle subsurface physical changes.

sum: This study investigates the combined effects of 3D laterally heterogeneous mantle viscosity and transient viscoelastic rheology on glacial isostatic adjustment (GIA) and sea-level change. Focusing on the West Antarctic Ice Sheet (WAIS), where the mantle is hot and has low viscosity, the authors simulate bedrock deformation under various ice sheet histories from the Last Interglacial to future projections. They demonstrate that transient viscoelasticity has a greater impact on decadal-to-centennial timescales than 3D Maxwell viscoelasticity alone, with 3D transient uplift rates roughly doubling those predicted by 3D Maxwell models. This highlights the critical need for fully coupled ice-sheet-solid-Earth models to accurately predict ice sheet stability and sea-level rise. The study also contrasts these findings with the ancient Laurentide ice sheet, which overlies a colder, higher-viscosity mantle.

sum: This study applies autocorrelation to teleseismic P- and S-wave coda to estimate the compressional-to-shear wave-speed ratio (Vp/Vs) within the Antarctic Ice Sheet (AIS). By incorporating shear-wave reflections from S-wave coda alongside P-wave coda autocorrelation, the authors nearly double the number of resolved sites to 61, significantly improving spatial coverage in East and West Antarctica. The resulting map shows stable Vp/Vs ratios (~2.0) in East Antarctica, but higher variability (2.1 to 2.2) in West Antarctica. Synthetic modeling suggests these elevated ratios in West Antarctica are caused by reduced shear-wave velocities in the lower ice layer, driven by ice anisotropy and partial melt or interstitial water from high geothermal heat flux.

sum: This study investigates the causative fault of the 2024 Mw4.8 New Jersey intraplate earthquake. By integrating relocated aftershocks, LiDAR topographic analysis, field geological mapping, and laboratory friction experiments, the authors identify a previously unmapped NNE-striking fault zone named the 'Mountainville Fault' (MF). Field observations reveal poorly coalesced fracture clusters lacking a breakthrough principal slip surface, indicating an immature fault zone. Frictional experiments and slip tendency analysis demonstrate that the MF is frictionally unstable and critically oriented for failure under the regional stress field, potentially aided by deep fluid-rock alterations. The findings highlight the seismic hazard posed by elusive, immature intraplate faults.

sum: This study presents an automated workflow for determining earthquake focal mechanisms in Italy using a deep learning approach. The authors combine a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trained on the INSTANCE catalog (over 450,000 waveforms) for P-wave polarity prediction with the SKHASH algorithm. The CNN achieves 96% accuracy in polarity classification. Tested on 15,420 events (240,335 waveforms) and validated against 300 Time Domain Moment Tensor (TDMT) solutions, the workflow yields a median Kagan angle of 28.7°. This automated method offers a reliable way to determine focal mechanisms for low-magnitude events (M 0–4.0) where traditional moment tensor inversions are challenging, enhancing regional seismotectonic monitoring.

sum: This study evaluates how tectonic geodetic strain accommodates earthquakes by comparing geodetic, geologic, and seismologic moment rates across the western United States (WUS). Utilizing datasets from the 2023 U.S. National Seismic Hazard Model (NSHM23-WUS), the authors implement a 'floating footprint' approach to calculate 'moment rate deviation' (MRD), representing the surplus or deficit of geodetic moment rate relative to geologic and seismologic rates. They find that high-strain plate boundary regions exhibit low MRD, indicating geodetic strain closely reflects the historical earthquake record. Conversely, low-strain intraplate regions show high MRD, where geodetic rates exceed geologic and seismologic estimates. This suggests geodetic data can reliably inform earthquake budgets and off-fault deformation in well-characterized interplate regions, but caution is required in intraplate settings.
本研究对比美西大地测量、地质和地震矩释放率以评估地震预算。利用NSHM23-WUS数据，通过滑动窗口方法计算矩释放率偏差。结果表明，高应变率的板块边界区域偏差较小，大地测量形变能很好反映地震记录；而低应变率的板内区域偏差较高。该成果为在地震危险性分析中引入大地测量形变提供了定量依据。

sum: This study investigates the mechanism of seismic rupture nucleation in semi-brittle oceanic shear zones, focusing on melt-mediated pore evolution. By analyzing the microstructures of deformed rocks from oceanic settings, the authors demonstrate how the interaction between melt migration and pore development facilitates localized damage and ductile fracturing. This melt-pore feedback lowers the shear strength of the shear zone, enabling seismic ruptures to nucleate and propagate under semi-brittle conditions near the brittle-ductile transition. The findings provide a new physical mechanism for microearthquakes observed along mid-ocean ridges and oceanic transform faults, highlighting the critical role of transient melt-rock interactions in governing deep seismicity.

sum: This study investigates the decadal-scale acceleration of aseismic slip along the northern Japan Trench prior to the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-oki earthquake. By inverting GNSS velocity fields from 1998 and 2009 using a mechanically motivated model, the authors show that this transient acceleration can be explained by creep-front propagation that progressively erodes heterogeneously locked asperities. The model results indicate that inferred asperities shrank from occupying 66% of their historical rupture areas in 1998 to 37% in 2009, representing a substantial expansion of aseismic creep. These shrinkage rates align with fracture-mechanics predictions for plausible coseismic stress drops, demonstrating that megathrust locking can evolve significantly over decadal timescales.

sum: This paper introduces GeoDMB, a contribution-aware dynamic multi-modal balance framework designed for natural-hazard detection and epicenter localization. Traditional multi-modal fusion methods use static weights, which fail when individual data streams degrade. GeoDMB addresses this by dynamically estimating per-modality reliability and cross-modal consistency to compute time-varying fusion weights, backed by a gating mechanism for graceful degradation. The authors also present GeoHazard-MM, a new multi-modal dataset aligning IRIS seismic, Sentinel-1 InSAR, and IMS infrasound data for 3,200 global events (2018–2024). Evaluated on this dataset, GeoDMB achieves an 88.9% detection F1 score and an 8.6 km localization error, demonstrating superior robustness against modality dropout compared to conventional fusion baselines.

sum: The paper introduces TREMORS (Text Referenced Event Mapping and Output Renderer for Seismographs), an agentic framework designed to automate seismic data retrieval across multiple heterogeneous datacenters. Utilizing large language model (LLM) reasoning within a constrained execution graph (LangGraph), TREMORS translates natural language queries into a portable intermediate schema. This schema drives workflows for both event-based and continuous waveform acquisition. The framework addresses the challenges of domain expertise requirements, user burden, and reproducibility in seismic data procurement. By providing a modular and portable solution, TREMORS bridges the gap between scientific intent and distributed seismic data systems, facilitating the creation of high-quality, AI-ready datasets.

sum: This paper presents a generalized matched filtering (GMF) workflow to enhance seismic data resolution and reflector clarity. The method approximates the source wavelet using Wiener inverse filtering, applies blue reflectivity modifications (3 dB/octave amplitude compensation and +pi/4 phase correction), and introduces a +pi/2 phase correction for alignment. Crucially, GMF modifies the conventional matched-filter equation to explicitly incorporate thin-layer responses, accounting for seismic wavelet differential effects. To prevent noise amplification, frequency-based regularization differentiation is integrated. Validated on synthetic and field datasets, GMF achieves wavelet compression and phase correction within the existing bandwidth, improving thin-bed resolution and reflector coherence without artificial spectral broadening.

sum: This study quantifies multiscale fault-zone connectivity at Kivetty, Finland, by integrating legacy deep-borehole data (packer tests, downhole logs, pumping tests) with new core logging, laboratory petrophysics, mineral mapping, and X-ray computed tomography (XCT). The authors show that the most transmissive intervals occur within the fault core, dominated by breccia-open and altered-leached granitic rocks. These rocks exhibit high porosity (up to 30%) and permeability (~10^-13 m^2 at 50 MPa), with XCT revealing up to 94% connected pore space. At the borehole scale, permeability is concentrated in discrete sub-intervals, and hydraulic responses up to 1 km indicate kilometer-scale connectivity. The novelty lies in demonstrating that coupled brittle deformation and hydrothermal alteration can generate and preserve highly connected pore networks through brecciation and leaching, allowing crystalline fault cores to act as major conduits for large-scale fluid flow rather than seals.

sum: This paper presents a semi-analytical solution based on the Uniform Theory of Diffraction (UTD) to model the scattering and topographic amplification of plane SH waves by step-like rock slopes. Traditional wave function expansion methods struggle with high-frequency divergence and non-closed boundaries. By partitioning the slope into two semi-infinite wedge domains and using global ray tracing, the authors incorporate second-order coupled diffraction terms with a slope-diffraction correction to describe crest-to-toe interactions. Numerical evaluations in both frequency and time domains reveal frequency-selective interference and spatial variability. Under horizontal grazing incidence, energy focuses on the leeward face, while oblique incidence causes local resonance. The study demonstrates that maximum amplification does not always occur at the slope crest, providing crucial insights for seismic hazard assessment and engineering design in mountainous regions.

sum: This study presents a high-resolution 3D seismic velocity model of the lithosphere beneath southeastern Tibet using full-waveform tomography (FWT). By exploiting regional earthquake waveforms, the authors image the complex crustal and upper mantle structures. The key finding is the clear evidence of dual crustal low-velocity zones (LVZs) at different depths within the crust. These dual LVZs suggest that crustal deformation in southeastern Tibet is governed by hybrid tectonic processes, combining both channel flow in the middle-to-lower crust and block-bounding strike-slip faulting. This model provides crucial constraints on the geodynamics of the Tibetan Plateau's outward expansion.

sum: This study presents an improved template-based detection method for acoustic emissions (AEs) in laboratory rock friction experiments. To overcome noise challenges, the method utilizes a two-stage metric: coherency to detect weak AEs in noisy waveforms, and kurtosis to identify events located away from the template hypocenters. Applying this framework to a large-scale rock friction experiment, the authors detected 2.1 times more AE events than the standard STA/LTA technique. The resulting high-resolution catalog reveals accelerating foreshock activity, low b-values, and distinct pre-mainshock foreshock migration in some sequences, while highlighting significant variability in nucleation behaviors across different sequences. This method is highly effective for environments with time-varying, unknown noise spectra.
本文提出了一种改进的模板匹配声发射（AE）检测方法，用于实验室岩石摩擦实验。该方法采用双阶段指标：相干性用于提取噪声中的微弱AE信号，峭度用于检测偏离模板震源的事件。将该方法应用于大规模岩石摩擦实验数据，检测到的AE事件数量是传统STA/LTA方法的2.1倍。高分辨率目录揭示了主震前震群的加速活动、……

sum: This paper presents a novel method to invert for the seismic attenuation (Q) of fault zone trapped waves using spectral decay analysis of amplitude ratios from events at varying propagation distances. The method is theoretically developed by analogy with Love waves and validated synthetically. Applying this method to dense portable arrays (B2 and B4) across the 2019 Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest earthquake rupture reveals distinct damage zone properties. The 'horse tail' termination segment (array B4) exhibits high attenuation (Q ~ 30-40) and significant velocity reduction (~20-30%), whereas the central fault segment (array B2) shows lower attenuation (Q ~ 50-70) and velocity reduction (~10-15%). These findings suggest that horse-tail structures are more fragmented, fluid-rich, and compliant than central fault segments, providing a generalized framework for high-resolution near-fault attenuation imaging.

sum: This paper introduces ROMNet, a hybrid approach combining reduced order modeling (ROM) and machine learning for acoustic waveform inversion. Standard full-waveform inversion (FWI) suffers from cycle skipping due to the highly nonlinear and oscillatory forward map. While ROM-based inversion avoids cycle skipping by computing an algebraic surrogate of the wave operator, mapping this ROM to the wave speed is computationally expensive. ROMNet addresses this by training a neural network to map the ROM matrix to a simplified surrogate with an explicit wave-speed dependence. Numerical tests on random Gaussian media and the GeoFWI dataset demonstrate that ROMNet significantly reduces computational costs and outperforms direct ROM inversion and deep learning baselines like InversionNet and Fourier-DeepONet.

sum: This paper presents the first passive seismic dataset from a network of up to 15 broadband ocean bottom seismometers (OBS) deployed around the Jøtul hydrothermal vent field on the ultraslow-spreading Knipovich Ridge from July 2023 to August 2024. The authors address key OBS data processing challenges, including correcting nonlinear clock drift via ambient noise cross-correlation and determining sensor orientation using Rayleigh wave polarization. Analysis of probabilistic power spectral densities reveals double-frequency microseismic noise, sediment/current-related noise (0.2-0.4 s), and radio beacon antenna vibrations (0.16 s). Despite these noise sources, the network successfully records local, regional, and teleseismic earthquakes, as well as air-gun signals, providing a valuable dataset for studying seismicity, magmatism, and hydrothermal circulation at ultraslow spreading ridges.

sum: This study presents a high-resolution seismic catalog of the Tuscan Magmatic Province, Italy, using a temporary broadband network from 2020 to 2021. Employing machine learning detection and probabilistic location, the authors identified 1,944 earthquakes (Mw -0.2 to 2.8), four times more than regional catalogs. The seismicity clusters along a NW-SE strip near the Monte Amiata and Larderello-Travale geothermal systems. A prominent swarm of over 500 events shows upward hypocenter migration (200-600 m/h) and high hydraulic diffusivity (10-15 m^2/s), indicating fluid diffusion. The authors propose a valve-type mechanism where tectonic failure initiates fault opening, enabling fluid advection that sustains seismicity.

sum: The authors present a 3-D shear wave velocity and azimuthal anisotropy model of Antarctica down to 600 km depth using a multi-mode Rayleigh waveform fitting technique. They employ a reversible-jump Markov Chain Monte Carlo (rj-MCMC) approach to search the model space for path-averaged vertically polarized shear wave velocity profiles. The resulting model reveals a distinct east-west dichotomy in both velocity and anisotropy directions, reflecting different deformation histories. Azimuthal anisotropy is concentrated in the top 300 km, peaking at 100–200 km depth beneath the East Antarctica craton. Crucially, depth-dependent changes in the fast direction between 75 km and 150 km depth suggest lithospheric layering within the craton, likely linked to its ancient formation history.

sum: This study investigates the long-term spatiotemporal evolution of postseismic deformation following the 2020 Mw 7.0 Samos earthquake. By combining campaign and continuous GNSS observations from 18 stations over a 4.5-year period, the authors model postseismic decay using linear, logarithmic, exponential, and combined logarithmic-exponential functions. The optimal model for each station is selected using the corrected Akaike Information Criterion (AICc) and validated via Monte Carlo simulations. The results reveal a highly heterogeneous postseismic deformation field, with characteristic relaxation times ranging from 182.6 to 730.5 days (median of 438.3 days). This work demonstrates that integrating sparse campaign GNSS with continuous data within a robust statistical framework can effectively constrain long-term postseismic processes and lithospheric rheology.

sum: This study reconstructs the source-to-sink system linking the southeastern Tibetan Plateau to the Yinggehai Basin using petrographic, heavy mineral, and zircon U-Pb geochronological data. The authors identify distinct provenance signatures for the Simao Block, Sichuan-Yunnan Block, and the Ailao Shan-Red River Fault Zone (ARRFZ). They show that detrital contribution from the Sichuan-Yunnan Block to the Red River increased significantly after 10.5 Ma, marking an eastward propagation of tectono-geomorphic uplift and constraining the ARRFZ's left-to-right strike-slip inversion to no later than 10.5 Ma.

sum: This study investigates newly identified Rhyacian to Orosirian meta-igneous rocks (ca. 2.06–1.88 Ga) in the northwestern Gyeonggi Massif, South Korea, using zircon U-Pb-Hf isotopes and whole-rock geochemistry. The 2.06 Ga garnet-amphibole granite gneiss indicates an arc-related extensional regime. The 1.93 Ga tonalitic gneiss shows adakitic features and thickened crustal signatures (42–74 km), suggesting derivation from Archean mafic lower crust during syn-collisional thickening. The 1.88 Ga biotite granite gneiss reflects post-collisional extension. These successive magmatic events are geochemically and temporally comparable to the Liao-Ji Belt of the eastern North China Craton, suggesting a shared Paleoproterozoic tectonic history.

sum: This study investigates the distribution of carbon within Mercury during its early evolution. Through high-pressure, high-temperature metal-silicate partitioning experiments under varying oxygen fugacities, the authors demonstrate that carbon becomes significantly less siderophile under the extremely reducing conditions relevant to Mercury. This behavior promotes carbon retention in the silicate magma ocean, leading to the flotation of a primary graphite crust. Thermodynamic modeling indicates that oxygen fugacities between IW-6 and IW-6.5 best match the graphite crust thickness observed by the MESSENGER spacecraft. Consequently, Mercury's core remains carbon-poor (<5000 µg/g), suggesting its density deficit is driven by other light elements like silicon and sulfur. The novelty lies in experimentally constraining carbon's redox-dependent behavior under Mercury-like reducing conditions to link its surface geology with its deep internal structure.

sum: This study introduces the Potential Economic Value (PEV) framework to evaluate the utility of volcanic eruption forecasts by balancing precautionary actions against catastrophic losses. Applying machine-learning forecasts to continuous seismic data from five volcanoes—including retrospective analyses of the 2019 Whakaari (New Zealand) and 2014 Ontake (Japan) eruptions—the authors demonstrate that non-forecasted (missed) eruptions carry disproportionate consequences compared to manageable false alarms. The results show that adopting more precautionary warning thresholds could reduce socio-economic losses by 30–90%. The study highlights that effective forecasting should prioritize minimizing missed eruptions over maximizing overall accuracy, provided that the increased frequency of alerts is managed to maintain public trust.

sum: This study investigates how rupture dynamics are influenced by the aspect ratio of rectangular PMMA velocity-weakening (VW) asperities and their confinement by Teflon velocity-strengthening (VS) patches. Using laboratory earthquake experiments, the authors found that increasing confinement (by reducing free surfaces) or increasing the VW asperity aspect ratio stabilizes fault slip, requiring higher normal stress to transition from aseismic to seismic slip. These geometric and boundary conditions also reduce seismic moment (M0) and increase corner frequency (fc), both controlled primarily by the shorter dimension of the VW asperity. High-aspect-ratio asperities exhibit more unidirectional rupture propagation and are more prone to erosion by surrounding VS regions, whereas square asperities show more complex ruptures. This work highlights the critical role of asperity geometry and surrounding stability in controlling earthquake nucleation, propagation, and source characteristics.
本文通过实验室地震实验，研究了速度弱化微凸体的长宽比及边界约束对破裂动力学的影响。结果表明，增加约束或提高长宽比会稳定断层滑动，提高无震-有震转变所需的法向应力。高约束和高长宽比还会降低地震矩并提高拐角频率，两者主要受微凸体较短维度控制。该研究揭示了微凸体几何与边界条件对震源特性的控制作用。

sum: This study analyzes a 19-year waveform dataset of M3-5.5 repeating earthquakes along the Tohoku-Hokkaido megathrust to quantify rupture repeatability. The authors observe strong spatial clustering of hypocenters and centroids, persistent hierarchical fault structures, and systematic downdip hypocenter-centroid directivity. They find unexpectedly limited rupture repeatability among classified repeaters. To explain these observations, they propose a hierarchical fault model defining 'hierarchical repeaters' that bridge hypocenter repeaters (similar initiation) and centroid repeaters (similar termination). The findings highlight how geometric controls influence rupture recurrence and suggest intrinsic limits on earthquake predictability. If self-similarity holds, these hierarchical geometric controls may scale up to giant megathrust events.
本研究利用东北-北海道俯冲带19年波形数据，定量分析了M3-5.5级重复地震的破裂重复性。发现震源和质心存在强空间聚集、分级断层结构及系统性向深部破裂直向性。作者提出分级断层模型，定义了连接“震源重复”与“质心重复”的“分级重复地震”。结果表明几何控制显著影响破裂复发，并限制了地震的可预测性。

sum: This study presents an observation-constrained hydromechanical model to explain the 2011 Prague, Oklahoma, earthquake sequence triggered by wastewater injection. By coupling pore-pressure diffusion, frictional slip, elastic interactions, and local undrained poroelastic feedback, the authors simulate 18 years of hydraulic buildup and the three-event cascade. The model reveals that while the second event increased normal compression on the third fault (inhibiting slip), undrained poroelastic feedback offset this clamping effect, enabling dynamic rupture. The findings highlight a two-way coupling where injection prepares the system hydraulically, but rupture-induced stress changes and poroelastic feedback dictate subsequent cascade evolution.
本文建立流固耦合模型，解释了废水注入诱发的2011年普拉格地震序列。模型耦合了孔隙压扩散、摩擦滑动与局部不排水孔隙弹性反馈，重现了18年水压积累及三阶段地震级联。结果表明，不排水孔隙弹性反馈抵消了第二场地震对第三条断层的夹持作用，促成了动态破裂，揭示了注入与破裂应力反馈的双向耦合机制。

sum: This study performs ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations of supercritical water at Earth's mantle conditions (1, 5, and 10 GPa, 1000 K) to evaluate the impact of van der Waals (vdW) dispersion corrections. By comparing PBE, PBE-D3, RPBE-D3, and SCAN exchange-correlation functionals, the authors find that structural, diffusion, and vibrational discrepancies between functionals are smaller under extreme conditions than at ambient conditions. While vdW corrections do not significantly alter the water structure at high pressure and temperature, the oxygen-hydrogen bond strength plays a critical role in proton transfer, with PBE and PBE-D3 showing higher transfer rates. This work provides molecular insights into deep-Earth fluids and guides functional selection for future AIMD simulations.
本研究利用第一性原理分子动力学模拟了地幔条件（1-10 GPa, 1000 K）下的超临界水，评估了范德华色散校正的影响。对比多种泛函发现，极端温压下各泛函间的性质差异较常温下减小。范德华作用对极端条件下的水结构影响有限，但氧氢键强度显著影响质子转移。该工作为深部地球流体模拟的泛函选择提供了重要指导……

sum: This study investigates the stress interaction between the 2026 Mw 6.8 Kumamoto earthquake and the 2016 Mw 7.1 Kumamoto earthquake sequence. Using waveform inversion of strong-motion records, the authors estimate the 2026 earthquake's source process and calculate the Coulomb failure stress changes (ΔCFS) from both events. The 2026 hypocenter was located in a positive ΔCFS region from the 2016 sequence, indicating stress-triggered rupture initiation. The main slip region of the 2026 event was adjacent to the 2016 rupture, with southwestward growth likely limited by complex fault geometry. Finally, the 2026 coseismic slip increased ΔCFS on the southwestern extension of the Hinagu fault, highlighting elevated seismic hazard in that region.

sum: This study models shape preferred orientation (SPO) versus akimotoite fabric-induced (lattice preferred orientation) azimuthal anisotropy to investigate the subslab lower-mantle transition zone (520-660 km) beneath subduction zones. The authors demonstrate that the widespread azimuthal anisotropy observed in this region can be explained by unresolved small-scale heterogeneities. This suggests that the lower transition zone is compositionally heterogeneous, providing an alternative explanation to purely deformation-induced mineral alignment.

sum: This study evaluates the application of Ambient Noise Tomography (ANT) for district-scale (tens of kilometers) mineral exploration using a network of 30 Sercel WiNG Micro-ElectroMechanical System (MEMS) accelerometers deployed along a 50 km profile across the Kansanshi Cu-Au mine in Zambia. The ANT method successfully imaged a significant body of metal source sediments multiple kilometers thick beneath the mine, as well as structures associated with mineralizing fluid expulsion. The novelty lies in proving that cost-effective, nodal MEMS accelerometers can be scaled up from local, shallow imaging to district-scale exploration, providing a valuable and affordable tool for greenfield mineral exploration.

sum: This paper presents a novel framework for thermochemical full-waveform inversion (FWI) that directly inverts seismic waveforms for mantle temperature and chemical composition. By integrating FWI with mineral physics, the forward model interpolates pre-calculated thermodynamic tables of density and wave speeds. The gradient of the objective function is computed using the chain rule, splitting it into a seismic part (via the adjoint method) and a thermodynamic part (via analytical derivatives of the interpolation function). To mitigate the temperature-composition trade-off, a linear parameter transformation is applied before optimization. The method is successfully demonstrated on 2-D synthetic models with thermal and compositional anomalies, offering a promising path to reduce non-uniqueness in mantle imaging.
本文提出了一种将全波形反演（FWI）与矿物物理学结合的热化学FWI框架，可直接利用波形反演地幔温度和化学组分。前向模拟基于预计算的密度及波速热力学表插值。利用链式法则将梯度分解为地震伴随部分和热力学解析部分，并通过线性参数变换缓解温度与组分的权衡。二维合成测试验证了该方法降低地幔成像多解性的潜力。

sum: This dataset contains vertical deformation data from 2020-2021 InSAR observations at Lake Mead, alongside elastic, viscoelastic (Maxwell), and poroelastic simulation results. These models are designed to decouple multiscale lithospheric responses to intense drought. The viscoelastic simulation utilizes a two-layer Maxwell model with an elastic layer thickness of 32 km and a viscous layer viscosity of 3×10^19 Pa·s. The dataset serves as a key resource for studying hydrological loading, poroelastic effects, and crustal rheology.

sum: This study estimates heat flow beneath the forearc slopes of Hyuga-nada and Cape Muroto in the Nankai Trough using seismic reflection data to identify Bottom Simulating Reflectors (BSRs). The authors find regional heat flow contrasts across the Kyushu-Palau Ridge reflecting lithospheric age differences, alongside localized low heat flow anomalies near subducted seamounts. A 3D thermal model suggests these local anomalies are caused by rapid sedimentation, hydrothermal cooling, or fluid advection. Seismic profiles show complex faulting and diapiric structures around the seamounts. These findings provide critical constraints on how subducted seamounts modify the mechanical strength and deformation of the forearc, helping to explain the spatial distribution of shallow slow earthquakes and tremors in the region.

sum: This paper presents a direction-aware masked autoencoder (MAE) designed for 3D post-stack seismic representation learning and transfer to cross-area acoustic impedance inversion. Recognizing the physical differences between lateral reflector continuity and vertical waveform characteristics, the authors introduce anisotropic tokenization, direction-aware representation, trace-aligned tube masking, and specialized reconstruction constraints. Testing on field data shows that reconstruction fidelity does not directly correlate with downstream transferability. When applied to cross-area acoustic impedance inversion with limited target-area well control, the proposed framework reduces normalized root-mean-square error by 20.8% compared to conventional MAE. This demonstrates the importance of incorporating physical directional priors into self-supervised seismic deep learning.

sum: This study investigates the distinct roles of seismic and aseismic slip in regulating crustal permeability during fault reactivation. Using controlled pore pressure stepping experiments, the authors observe a non-monotonic permeability evolution: permeability initially decreases with slip, then increases, resulting in a net permeability gain. This behavior correlates with the ratio of seismic moment to the total (seismic plus aseismic) moment, where aseismic slip contributes approximately 90% of the total deformation. To explain these observations, they develop a mechanistic model that couples shear dilation with fracture compaction. The findings highlight that aseismic slip plays an indispensable role in controlling permeability evolution, offering critical insights into fluid-fault interactions and reservoir mechanics.
本研究探讨了断层活化过程中有震与无震滑动对地壳渗透率演化的不同作用。通过受控孔隙压力阶梯实验，作者发现渗透率随滑动呈现先降低后升高的非单调变化，最终实现净增加。该演化规律与有震矩占总矩（有震加无震）的比例密切相关，其中无震滑动贡献了约90%的总矩。为此，研究团队建立了一个结合剪切胀缩与裂隙压实的力学……

Laboratory measurements of permeability, slip, and seismic/aseismic moments during pore pressure-induced fault reactivation.

Permeability evolves non-monotonically (decreases then increases) during reactivation, with aseismic slip accounting for ~90% of the total moment and dominating permeability evolution.
渗透率在活化中呈非单调变化（先降后升），无震滑动占总矩约90%并主导了渗透率演化。
Laboratory-scale results and simplified model assumptions may not scale directly to complex, heterogeneous natural fault zones.
实验室尺度观测及简化的模型假设可能无法直接推广至复杂的天然非均匀断层带。
First to experimentally isolate and mechanistically model the competing, non-monotonic effects of seismic and aseismic slip on fault permeability.

Discovered a non-monotonic permeability evolution (initial decrease followed by increase) during fault reactivation.
Quantified that aseismic slip accounts for ~90% of the total deformation moment during reactivation.
Developed a mechanistic model incorporating shear dilation and fracture compaction to explain the observed permeability behavior.

sum: This study models the coupled formation of early oceans and felsic crust on Earth following magma-ocean solidification. Under high atmospheric pressure, water release from the primary crust is modulated, leading to the formation of a hydrated primary crust, shallow oceans, and felsic magmatism. This process facilitated the rapid emergence of land and prebiotic environments like lakes and lagoons. The findings suggest that a planet's initial water content and atmosphere-geosphere interactions are key to the emergence of habitable environments on early Earth and rocky exoplanets.
本研究模拟了岩浆洋固结后早期地球海洋与长英质地壳的耦合形成。在高大气压下，初生地壳的水分释放受到调节，形成水化初生壳与浅海，并引发长英质岩浆作用。这促进了陆地快速涌现，并创造了湖泊等有利于生命起源前化学的环境。研究表明，行星初始水含量及大气-地质圈相互作用决定了早期地球与岩石系外行星的宜居性。

t: Coupled numerical modeling of atmosphere-geosphere interactions, focusing on water release, crustal hydration, and felsic magmatism during and after magma-ocean solidification.
耦合大气-地质圈相互作用的数值模拟，研究岩浆洋固结后的水分释放与地壳水化。
Synthetic planetary parameters representing early Earth conditions, including initial water content, atmospheric pressure, and primary crustal compositions.
代表早期地球条件的合成行星参数，包括初始水含量、大气压力和初生地壳成分。
High atmospheric pressure modulated water release, forming a hydrated primary crust, shallow oceans, and felsic magmatism, which rapidly established prebiotic environments like lakes.
高气压促进了水化初生壳、浅海与长英质岩浆作用，快速建立了湖泊等生命起源前环境。
The study is limited by simplified atmospheric and geodynamical assumptions and the lack of direct Hadean geological samples for validation.
该研究受限于简化的大气和地球动力学假设，且缺乏直接的冥古期地质样品进行验证。
Coupling atmosphere-geosphere interactions to show that early Hadean conditions naturally and rapidly produced shallow oceans, felsic crust, and subaerial prebiotic environments.
耦合大气地质圈作用，揭示冥古期快速产生浅海与陆上生命起源环境

证明了高大气压会导致水化初生地壳和浅海的形成。
展示了这些条件如何促进长英质岩浆作用以及湖泊和潟湖等生命起源前环境的快速涌现。

sum: This study applies the normalized inner product (NIP) method to analyze single-station three-component seismic data from the August 2026 slope collapse north of Langtang Lirung, Nepal. By measuring the dominance of retrograde Rayleigh waves from the collapse direction at stations 57 and 132 km away, the author demonstrates that NIP values significantly increased during the pre-collapse amplitude rise, distinguishing the signal from background noise and earthquake arrivals. Post-collapse, NIP successfully tracked the debris-flow front propagation. This work highlights the utility of single-station polarization analysis for monitoring slope instability and hazards in sparse seismic networks.
本研究利用归一化内积（NIP）方法，分析了2026年尼泊尔蓝塘里弄山体滑坡期间的单台三分量地震数据。结果显示，在滑坡前振幅上升阶段，NIP值显著升高，呈现出指向滑坡方向的逆行瑞利波偏振特征。滑坡后，NIP成功追踪了泥石流前锋的运移。该研究展示了单台偏振分析在稀疏台网下监测山体失稳与灾害预警的独特价值……

t: Uses the normalized inner product (NIP) on single-station three-component seismic data to measure the dominance of retrograde Rayleigh waves from a specific azimuth.
利用单台三分量地震数据的归一化内积（NIP）来测量特定方位角逆行瑞利波的优势度。
Three-component seismic waveforms recorded at two stations (57 km and 132 km away) during the August 26, 2026 Langtang Lirung slope collapse.
2026年8月26日蓝塘里弄山体滑坡期间，两个台站（相距57和132千米）记录的三分量地震波形。
NIP rose significantly before the collapse, staying above the 95th percentile for 9 minutes at the far station, and successfully tracked post-collapse debris-flow propagation.
滑坡前NIP显著升高，在远台超95%分位数持续9分钟，并成功追踪了滑坡后的泥石流运移。
Performance depends on the presence of clear retrograde Rayleigh waves and requires prior knowledge of the collapse azimuth.
其性能取决于是否存在清晰的逆行瑞利波，且需要预先知晓滑坡方位角。
Demonstrates that single-station polarization can detect pre-collapse signals and track debris flows over regional distances (up to 132 km) in sparse networks.
证明了单台偏振分析可在稀疏台网中实现区域距离（达132千米）上的滑坡前兆检测与泥石流追踪。

kc: Demonstrated that single-station polarization (NIP) can detect pre-collapse seismic signatures from a specific slope direction.
Tracked the post-collapse debris-flow front propagation using single-station data.
Provided a viable hazard monitoring method for regions with sparse seismic networks.
证明了单台偏振分析（NIP）能够检测到来自特定坡向的滑坡前兆地震信号。

为地震台网稀疏地区的滑坡灾害监测提供了一种可行的方法。

Single-station three-component polarization analysis.

sum: This study evaluates seismoacoustic source localization using the 2025 Accurate Energetic Systems accidental explosion in Tennessee. It compares two methods: the Seismoacoustic Bayesian Event Locator (SABEL) algorithm, which integrates seismic and infrasound arrival times with prior models, and a seismoacoustic reverse time migration (RTM) approach backpropagating enveloped waveforms. Results show that joint seismoacoustic solutions significantly reduce location uncertainty compared to seismic-only data. For SABEL, a propagation-model-informed celerity-range prior yields the smallest uncertainties. For RTM, incorporating seismic data resolves the late origin-time bias inherent in infrasound-only migration, producing a narrower spatiotemporal stack. The study demonstrates that combining seismic and infrasound data improves localization accuracy and highlights how RTM can support arrival-time-based monitoring workflows.
本文以2025年田纳西州AES意外爆炸为案例，评估了地震-声学联合震源定位。研究对比了两种方法：结合地震与红外声波走时及先验模型的贝叶斯定位算法（SABEL），以及回传包络波形的逆时偏移（RTM）方法。结果表明，联合定位显著降低了仅用地震数据的定位不确定性。在SABEL中，基于传播模型的声速-距离先……

t: Combines the Seismoacoustic Bayesian Event Locator (SABEL) using arrival-time priors with a seismoacoustic reverse time migration (RTM) backpropagating enveloped waveforms.
结合了基于走时先验的贝叶斯定位（SABEL）与回传包络波形的逆时偏移（RTM）方法。
Seismic and infrasound waveforms recorded from the 10 October 2025 Accurate Energetic Systems accidental explosion in Tennessee.
收集并使用了2025年10月10日田纳西州AES意外爆炸事件的地震与红外声波波形数据。
Joint seismoacoustic inversion reduces the 90% confidence region by ~50% compared to seismic-only, and adding seismic data to infrasound RTM corrects late-biased origin times.
联合反演使定位不确定性降低约50%，加入地震数据纠正了RTM中红外声波的走时偏差。
Infrasound-only RTM suffers from late-biased origin times, and SABEL accuracy depends heavily on the quality of celerity priors.
仅用红外声波的RTM定位时间偏晚，且SABEL精度高度依赖于声速先验模型的准确性。
First systematic comparison of Bayesian arrival-time localization and waveform-based RTM using joint seismoacoustic data from a well-constrained accidental explosion.
首次利用真实爆炸事件，系统对比并融合了贝叶斯走时定位与波形逆时偏移方法。

kc: Demonstrated that joint seismoacoustic data fusion significantly reduces source location uncertainty compared to single-phenomenology (seismic-only) methods.
Evaluated three infrasound celerity priors for the SABEL algorithm, showing that a propagation-model-informed celerity-range prior yields the highest accuracy.
Showed that adding seismic data to infrasound RTM resolves the late-bias in origin time estimation and narrows the spatiotemporal stack.
证明了与单一物理方法（仅地震）相比，地震-声学联合数据融合能显著降低震源定位的不确定性。
评估了SABEL算法的三种红外声波声速先验，表明基于传播模型的声速-距离先验具有最高的精度。
展示了在红外声波RTM中加入地震数据可以解决发震时刻估计偏晚的问题，并使时空堆叠更收敛。

Seismoacoustic Reverse Time Migration (RTM) backpropagating enveloped waveforms.

It evaluates the Seismoacoustic Bayesian Event Locator (SABEL) algorithm to estimate posterior distributions of source location.

sum: This paper presents a deep-learning phase picker designed for seismo-acoustic conflict monitoring. Combining a U-net architecture for waveform feature extraction with a graph convolution module for network geometry, the model discriminates between seismic (P, S) and acoustic (IS) phases. Trained on manually labeled data from the Malyn array in Ukraine (2022), the method uses migration stacking on phase probabilities. It achieves a 54% increase in seismic event detections compared to traditional STA/LTA methods and identifies 557 previously undetected purely acoustic events, demonstrating the power of deep learning for real-time, high-resolution peace-keeping and conflict monitoring.

t: A deep-learning phase picker combining a U-net architecture for waveform features and a graph convolution module for network geometry to classify P, S, and acoustic phases.

sum: This study utilizes ambient seismic noise from four stations to investigate near-surface groundwater dynamics (NSGD) driven by a typhoon in a mountain watershed. By applying single-station cross-component correlations and the stretching method at 4–8 Hz, the authors estimate seismic velocity changes (dv/v). They observe spatially variable post-typhoon dv/v recovery times, ranging from ~10 days upstream to over 3 months downstream, which they attribute to thicker colluvium and fractured bedrock downstream. The concurrent decrease in dv/v and increase in groundwater levels indicate transient vertical coupling between shallow and deeper systems. This work demonstrates that a single extreme rainfall event can prolong watershed-scale NSGD, providing valuable insights into water residence times in mountainous regions.
本研究利用四个台站的背景地震噪声，探讨了台风引起的山区流域近地表地下水动态（NSGD）。通过在4-8 Hz频段应用单台跨分量互相关和拉伸法估算地震波速度变化（dv/v）。研究发现台风后dv/v恢复时间具有空间差异性，上游约10天，下游则长达3个月以上，这归因于下游较厚的崩积层和裂隙基岩。dv/v的持……

t: Single-station cross-component correlation and the stretching method were applied to continuous ambient noise at 4–8 Hz to estimate relative seismic velocity changes (dv/v).

Continuous ambient seismic noise from four stations in a mountain watershed, combined with hydrological (groundwater level) and meteorological (rainfall) records during a typhoon.

Post-typhoon dv/v recovery times varied from ~10 days upstream to over 3 months downstream, showing transient vertical coupling between shallow and deeper hydrological systems.

The study is limited by the sparse spatial coverage of only four seismic stations and potential trade-offs in interpreting dv/v changes.
研究受限于仅有四个地震台站的稀疏空间覆盖，且在解释dv/v变化时可能存在多解性。

Identified transient vertical coupling and subsequent decoupling between shallow and deeper hydrological systems during and after extreme rainfall.

Stretching method to estimate relative seismic velocity changes (dv/v) in the 4–8 Hz frequency band.
Joint analysis of seismic velocity changes with hydrological (groundwater level) and meteorological (rainfall) records.

在4-8 Hz频段内估算相对地震波速度变化（dv/v）的拉伸法。
将地震波速变化与水文（地下水位）和气象（降雨）记录进行联合分析。

sum: This study evaluates the sensitivity of higher-order ambient seismic noise correlations (specifically the re-correlation of reconstructed direct waves, or C3) to non-uniform noise source distributions. Using both field data and numerical simulations, the authors demonstrate that surface wavefields reconstructed via higher-order correlations do not mitigate directional source effects but can actually amplify them. This amplification leads to systematic errors in velocity estimates and subsequent subsurface tomographic images. Testing various auxiliary station configurations for the re-correlation process failed to resolve these biases and instead introduced further wavefield distortions. The findings caution against treating higher-order correlation as a universal enhancement technique without carefully accounting for source distribution effects.
本研究评估了高阶环境地震噪声互相关（即重建直达波的再相关，C3）对非均匀噪声源分布的敏感性。通过野外观测数据和数值模拟，作者表明利用高阶互相关重建的面波场不仅无法消除定向震源效应，反而会放大这些效应，从而导致速度估计和后续地下成像中出现系统性偏差。测试用于再相关过程的多种辅助台站分布也未能减轻这种偏……

t: Re-correlation of reconstructed direct waves (higher-order ambient noise correlation, C3) to image with asynchronous data.
重建直达波的再相关（高阶环境噪声互相关，C3），用于异步数据成像。
Field seismic data and synthetic simulations of ambient noise wavefields under directional source distributions.
定向震源分布下的野外地震数据和环境噪声波场合成模拟。
Higher-order correlations amplify directional source effects, causing systematic velocity estimation errors in both local and far-field imaging.
高阶互相关放大了定向震源效应，导致局部和远场成像中出现系统性速度估计误差。
Auxiliary station distributions cannot mitigate the source-induced bias and instead introduce additional wavefield distortions.
辅助台站分布无法减轻震源引起的偏差，反而会引入额外的波场畸变。
Demonstrates that higher-order correlation is not an all-purpose enhancement technique and can systematically bias velocity estimates due to source effects.
证明了高阶互相关并非万能的增强技术，震源效应会系统性地使速度估计产生偏差。

kc: Demonstrates that higher-order ambient noise correlations (C3) remain highly sensitive to directional noise source distributions.

Evaluates auxiliary station distributions and finds they do not mitigate bias but introduce additional wavefield distortions.
证明了高阶环境噪声互相关（C3）对定向噪声源分布仍高度敏感。

sum: This study presents high-resolution observations of sub-millimetric creep and slip reversals on the Altaquelle Fault in the southern Vienna Basin, preceding the 2021 Mw 4.2 intraplate earthquake sequence. Continuous 3D monitoring in a cave detected two slip reversals 15 and 4 days before the mainshock, showing oblique reverse-dextral slip and near-vertical dilation, which is opposite to the fault's long-term oblique normal sinistral kinematics. Precursory stress inversions align with earthquake focal mechanisms. Concurrently, InSAR vertical motion revealed regional deformation evolving from butterfly-shaped lobes to lenticular uplift. These integrated observations demonstrate that transient stress reorganization and subtle crustal deformation can precede intraplate earthquakes, providing valuable insights into earthquake preparation processes and fault mechanics.
本研究利用维也纳盆地断层洞穴监测和InSAR，首次观测到2021年Mw 4.2地震前兆的亚毫米级蠕变与滑动反转。主震前，监测捕捉到两次与长期运动相反的逆右旋斜滑。前兆应力反演与震源机制一致。同时，InSAR揭示区域形变由蝶形演变为透镜状隆起。这表明板内地震前存在短期应力重组，为地震孕育提供了关键观测……

t: Continuous 3D cave monitoring of fault creep combined with regional InSAR vertical deformation analysis and displacement stress inversion.
结合洞穴断层蠕变连续三维监测、区域InSAR垂直形变分析以及位移应力反演。
Sub-millimetric 3D creep measurements from Altaquelle Fault, regional InSAR deformation time series, and seismic focal mechanisms from the 2021 Vienna Basin sequence.
断层亚毫米级三维蠕变数据、区域InSAR形变序列及地震震源机制解。

在Mw 4.2地震前检测到两次逆右旋斜滑反转，并伴有区域透镜状隆起。

First high-resolution observation of precursory sub-millimetric fault slip reversals and contemporaneous regional geodetic deformation preceding an intraplate earthquake.
首次在高分辨率下观测到板内地震前的前兆断层滑动反转及同期区域形变。

kc: Detected high-resolution sub-millimetric creep and slip reversals preceding an intraplate earthquake.
Integrated fault-scale cave monitoring with regional InSAR observations to capture precursory deformation.
Demonstrated transient stress reorganization prior to the 2021 Mw 4.2 Vienna Basin earthquake.
首次检测到板内地震前高分辨率的亚毫米级蠕变和断层滑动反转。
结合断层尺度洞穴监测与区域InSAR观测，捕获了地震前兆形变。

sum: This study addresses the challenges of mapping lowermost mantle (D'') anisotropy using Sdiff splitting, such as apparent splitting from isotropic structures. The authors develop an automated measurement workflow using global wavefield simulations to exclude strongly SVdiff-polarized waves. Applying this to ~20 million seismograms yields a curated dataset of ~4,300 high-confidence Sdiff splitting measurements across 237 geographic bins (covering ~28% of the D'' layer). Clear splitting is observed in 55 bins, particularly beneath the northern Pacific. The study also characterizes directional dependence using backazimuth binning. The curated dataset and codes are made publicly available, providing a robust foundation for future geodynamical and seismological modeling of the core-mantle boundary region.
本研究利用全球波场模拟开发了自动测量流程，排除了强SVdiff偏振导致的视分裂，以准确提取D''层各向异性。应用于两千万个地震图后，获得了约4300个高置信度Sdiff分裂测量值，覆盖D''层28%的区域（237个网格）。其中55个网格（如北太平洋下方）显示出明显分裂。该研究还通过后方位角分箱表征了……

t: An automated Sdiff splitting measurement workflow that uses global wavefield simulations to identify and exclude strongly SVdiff-polarized waves, preventing apparent splitting from isotropic structures.
利用全球波场模拟排除强SVdiff偏振波的自动化Sdiff分裂测量方法。
A global dataset of approximately 20 million three-component seismograms, filtered to yield 4,300 high-confidence Sdiff splitting measurements.
包含约2000万个三分量地震图的全球数据集，筛选出4300个高置信度测量值。
Sdiff splitting mapped across 237 global geographic bins (28% of D''), with 55 bins showing clear splitting, particularly beneath the northern Pacific.
在237个地理网格中绘制了分裂图，其中55个网格显示出明显分裂。
The curated dataset covers only 28% of the D'' layer by surface area due to the uneven distribution of earthquakes and seismic stations.

Developing a simulation-validated automated workflow that systematically avoids isotropic-structure-induced apparent splitting to build a highly consistent global D'' anisotropy dataset.

sum: This study investigates seismicity (2015–2024) in the tectonically complex south-eastern Alps and Western Dinarides (SEAWD). The authors implement a multiscale relocation workflow starting with regional-scale relocation using a multi-iterative NonLinLoc Source-Specific Station Term (NLL-SSST) approach to account for velocity-model uncertainties. They identify seismic sequences using nearest-neighbour clustering and perform local-scale relocation using waveform-coherence-based NonLinLoc (NLL-coherence). This workflow achieves hundreds-of-meters resolution, identifying 71 sequences (mostly foreshock-mainshock-aftershock and mainshock-aftershock types). Principal component analysis characterizes sequence volumes and orientations, showing that most clusters define tabular structures corresponding to planar fault zones. The results highlight the structural complexity of the Alpine-Dinaric transition zone and provide new constraints on active seismogenic structures and seismic hazard.
本研究针对阿尔卑斯东南部和外迪纳拉山2015-2024年地震活动，提出多尺度重定位工作流。利用NLL-SSST进行区域重定位，通过最近邻聚类识别出71个地震序列，并用基于波形相干性的NLL-coherence进行局部重定位。结果达到百米级分辨率，揭示了复杂的板状断层结构，为该区域发震构造和地震危险性……

t: A multiscale relocation workflow combining regional-scale NLL-SSST, nearest-neighbour clustering for sequence identification, and local-scale waveform-coherence-based NonLinLoc (NLL-coherence) to resolve fine-scale structures.

Bulletin seismic catalogue from the Northeastern Italy Seismometer Network, recording seismicity between 2015 and 2024 in the south-eastern Alps and Western Dinarides (SEAWD).

sum: This paper presents a combined seismo-acoustic framework for automatic avalanche detection and characterization. Utilizing continuous data from a co-located array of five seismic and five infrasound sensors in Switzerland's Dischma Valley across five winter seasons, the authors analyze source parameters like apparent velocity and backazimuth. While infrasound array processing provides stable source parameters at low signal-to-noise ratios, seismic beamforming offers complementary robustness. The framework applies threshold-based rules to these parameters, signal amplitudes, and durations for detection, and uses cross-correlation between seismic and infrasound channels to identify avalanche types and flow regimes. Preliminary results demonstrate that integrating seismic and infrasound data significantly enhances detection robustness and enables basic avalanche characterization, offering a promising tool for real-time hazard mitigation and forecasting.
本文提出了一种结合地震与声学数据的雪崩自动检测与表征框架。研究利用瑞士迪施马山谷连续五个冬季的共置台阵数据（5个地震仪和5个次声传感器），提取视速度和反方位角等震源参数。次声阵列处理在低信噪比下表现稳定，而地震波束形成则提供互补的鲁棒性。该框架通过对震源参数、振幅和持续时间应用阈值规则进行雪崩检测，……
